review_description: Called into the office, was served quickly. All my questions were answered on the spot. The installers turned up on the day as promised, I did expect to see them as we had storms, rain hail and lightening! They manged to dodge the weather and came back and finished it off the next day. Dillon and Elliot the installers did a every good job, very neat and cleaned up after the job was finished.All the paper work was handled seamlessly.

I had my solar system installed yesterday and I could not be more pleased with the entire experience. The installation team, Daniel and Dylan, were outstanding – professional, highly knowledgeable, and courteous. Their attention to detail and commitment to ensuring everything was completed to the highest standard was very reassuring.From the very beginning, Sam provided exceptional guidance throughout the process. After years of considering solar and receiving multiple quotes from other companies, I often felt overwhelmed, pressured, and uncertain. In contrast, Sam explained everything clearly, answered all of my questions, and gave me complete confidence in my decision.The whole process, from consultation through to installation, was seamless and exceeded my expectations. I would not hesitate to recommend Solar Wholesalers to anyone considering solar. Their professionalism, expertise, and customer care set them apart from the rest.

Very happy with my decision to go with Solar Wholesalers, Sam helped guide me through the process of selecting appropriate size Solar and battery system to suit my needs without any sales spin.Quote was very competitive, quality and reliability of product depends on installation so this was key to my decision making process.Anthony did a really neat job on all of electrical work, minimal external conduits and completely rewired my switch board. I appreciate his attention to detail and listening to my requests.30 x Canadian Solar 440W panels paired with 10kW Fronius Symo Gen 24 inverter easily charges my 19kW BYD battery even on cloudy winter days.I did a lot of research, and hopefully this system will provide many years of trouble free service!

We had them install panels a few years back so when we wanted to add a battery ( before the rebate was announced) they were one of the companies we called for a quote.  Sam had a different solution to other suppliers which included more panels and explained why this would be the best option for our two phase system. We asked the other suppliers to do the same but eventually decided to go with the known supplier.The install was booked for the Monday after the weekend announcement of the battery rebate! I needn’t have worried Sam was on the case. He rang to give us options and we agreed to go ahead but not even wire up the battery.So not only did we get the rebate on the extra solar but now have the battery rebate too,System is working well and the extra solar makes all the difference.
Fantastic company to deal with, we were kept up to date through the whole process, customer service is excellent. Installers were great to deal with. Very happy with our solar system.

Very happy with Huglo from start to finish. Lee was fantastic at explaining the system and process and answered all of my many questions. The installation team were efficient, polite and respectful, they also cleaned up beautifully at the end of the day.Daniel has been great in keeping us informed and checking in regularly. We did have to wait nearly 2 months for the battery but that was a supply issue and was out of Huglo's control.Overall a very smooth and pleasant experience.We would highly recommend Huglo.

Huglo is a terrific company they installed our solar panels and now a battery. Their service has always been professional and delivered quickly. I would recommend this company to anyone who wants solar.

A seamless installation by Dorji and crew. We had to make some adjustments mid-way to avoid asbestos sheeting but all was done quickly and effectively. The advice I obtained prior to installation allowed me to plan the size of the system and we now have a full battery and power to export. The final product fits neatly on roof and the wall below.

All stages and steps in this process (from first contact to sign off) were trouble free and easy.  I was expecting to be confused with technical detail and specialist speak.  Not so - all communications have been in my language and all people I have communicated with have taken special care to ensure that I fully understood answers to my questions.The design, planning, offers of various options, discussions about cost and comparisons and pros and cons of the 3 options discussed were very clear and Huglo people were very patient with me.The site visit and subsequent installation visits were enjoyable for me.The installation team was professional, efficient, arrived on time and worked constantly from start to finish.  There was no stopping for phone calls or conversations other than discussions of approach to the task and planning for and solving site problems.The team was well integrated, were familiar and friendly with each other and the Supervisor appeared to me to be the first amongst equals (ie not an officious controller) and, consequently it was a harmonious and happy team.At the end of the job all debris and materials were removed and the place needed no cleaning or tidying by me.I can not fault Huglo in any way and will promote them when I am asked by neighbours and friends about how the process went.The new installation is working really well.  I have compared the performance of the old 5.9kW system which has been replaced by the new 11.875kW system and the difference is amazing.  See photo below - please ignore the first one (mistake) and I cannot work out how to remove it..  The weather conditions on the day before the changeover and the full day following were essentially identical.I couldn't be happier (or more impressed!)

From the moment I first started a conversation with about my solar requirements with the Lee and the team at Huglo I knew I was dealing with a professional organization and not the usual run of the mill salesman. I had some more difficult requirements and it was clear these were not only understood but planned for correctly well in advance. My PM Chloe was excellent in keeping my informed about the process before and after the install. The installation team were excellent and did a really neat job with my work. To summarize I highly recommend Huglo solar for anyone serious about their energy independence.

I had a fantastic experience with Huglo and could not recommend them more highly. It has been several months since Huglo installed my AIKO Solar and Sigenergy battery/EV charger system and I have been very satisfied with the installation and after sales service.After first contacting Huglo, Lee came out to our house to do an initial look around and to learn more about what we wanted. He spent lots of time with us and provided lots of relevant information. He was a great listener, explained the differences between different options and was never pushy (far from it!). Our quote was provided electronically and it was easy to work with Lee on a couple of minor changes before accepting it.Lee also visited again for a final site inspection, then on install day everything went really well. There was one small issue with the installation which Lee and the team were happy to address promptly and at no cost to make sure we were satisfied.When the system required its first software update I had some trouble installing it. I contacted Huglo and they were able to help me out remotely. Again it was dealt with very promptly and professionally.

After two days battling Mother Nature’s winds, the legends at Huglo Energy pushed through and delivered an awesome install today.Big thanks to the team for the hard work—how good does this setup look!Running a Sungrow Inverter + Sungrow Battery paired with Aiko 475W Stealth Black Panels—clean, sleek, and ready to power on.

From the initial contact of getting the quote all the way through to job completion, the Huglo team conducted themselves in a totally professional manner. Nick and his team arrived on time and kept the work area clean and tidy, and kept us informed of their progress throughout the project. I would highly recommend this company to anybody thinking of fitting a solar system their house.
The team was very helpful and efficient.  Their followup was great.

Talking to them during the quotation phase gave me great confidence and I wasn't disappointed by the installation team, who were fantastic. A minor issue was resolved quickly and the system works great.

I've just had a REAPower 20kW battery installed by Huglo.  From initial contact, through planning, booking, answering my dumb questions and the install and follow up, Tim and the team have excelled.  They were helpful in getting a product that suited my needs and the tech guys who did the install were efficient, polite, and effective - I have a working system!  I received a follow up call and the offer of ongoing support with the app and in evaluating electricity providers.Couldn't be happier and I would unreservedly recommend Huglo.

Purchased a battery adding to a domestic three year old solar system.  Good information before contracting; flexible with installation arrangements. Responsive to my inquiries during and post installation.  Easy to deal with.

This was a company that made the whole process a pleasure.The communication and options plus answers to questions helped make it easy to decide this was who I wanted to supply and install my battery and backup system, plus upgrade my meterbox. I can now say without a doubt I was  right.The team were efficient tidy and friendly. I would have no reservations at all with recommending this company if you want a high standard of work done.
Lee took the time to explain things in detail. This company doesn't cut corners and everyone has been a delight to deal with, from the boss, to the reception to the installers.

From the very first phone call to the final handover, Huglo made going solar a breeze. We had several somewhat unusual requests and the team worked with us to find the best solutions.1) Tim, our consultant, walked us through panel and inverter options in plain language, explained the pros and cons of each, and never tried to upsell. He offered us several options, explained their differences, and updated quotes aligning with our requests promptly.2) They modelled our daytime loads and future plans and designed a system that maximises self-consumption  (as we wanted).3) The day of installation went brilliantly. The team arrived on time, kept the site clean, and completed the job quickly and efficiently. They gave a heads up when they needed to switch off our electricity and guided through the system after the installation.4) Grid connection, meter upgrade and feed-in tariff switch were all handled behind the scenes, so we didn’t need to chase any forms.Overall, we are very happy with our system. Huglo delivered exactly what they promised. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone in Canberra or beyond looking for a reliable solar partner.

Contacted Amazon Energy to install a battery (30kWh Midea Hiconics) and 6.6kW solar panel system. Was very prompt with all the replies and the was helpful with all the questions. 10% deposit was paid. Due to a cancellation from another customer, my installation got pushed to the front and got schedule 2 days after the deposit (deposit to complete installation in 3 days!).The installation was done really well with nothing to fault. The place was left tidy afterwards with all rubbish removed.The installers were also really well knowledgable and were happy to answer all questions. Lee (director) also came to visit the installation to make sure everything was going to plan.Overall a great process. Now just need to see how reliable the Midea Hiconics is over the long term but I just wanted a simple battery system that just does its own thing without any fancy extras.

The quoting process was very good. The representative was friendly and answered all my questions. The quality of installation was great, the guys were polite and did the work efficiently (as far as I could tell). The final installation was neat and tidy. All the paperwork was done for me and they explained the system and got the app working . The whole system was working when they left. Very happy so far.

An interesting and ultimately good experience with Amazon Energy.They responded very quickly with a couple of similar options and I decided to go with the FoxEss system they offered - 6.6kW of Solar Panels, 5.5kW inverter and ~14kWh of battery - as this seemed the most appropriate.Also useful to know that it was the cheapest quote I got in terms of cost per kWh of batteries - this system was basically the same price as an alternative with a 10kWh battery.Since we use most of our power in the morning and then again in the evening I was keen to ensure we had enough storage to best use the power generated.I have previously installed 2 solar systems (without batteries) in 2011 and 2015 so have a good understanding of the generation vs use time patterns.Amazon were also quick to lock in an installation day - Monday 27 October 8am.On the day I got a message at 8.15am saying that the sales person's car had broken down but "the installers should be there" - they weren't. After replying that no one had arrived we heard they were stuck in traffic. I then found out there had been a bad accident at the Freeway exit and so understood why they were late. Unfortunately, as they didn't arrive until around 10.00am they were unable to finish on the day and said they would return on the next day.That afternoon I got an email requesting a review and payment, I answered that it was a bit premature for either.I again expected them at 8am, and arranged to work from home. They arrived at 9am and started work.At around 1pm they said they were nearly finished and started turning the system on. They got me on the app and linked to the inverter and I immediately saw that there was something wrong. Apparently the house was using 10kW, with only a fridge turned on I knew that was impossible. The team were obviously keen to get away and tried to tell me it was nothing to do with them as all they had done was remove the old solar and installed the new system and had not touched anything in the house. With the old 3kW system I knew that generally between 10am and 2pm we were exporting excess energy, so I explained that I didn't agree with them and that they needed to stay and sort the problem out. We then isolated several circuits and at one point discovered that the house was apparently exporting 10kW of power in addition to the 5kW being produced by the panels at the time. It was at this point that the electrician agreed something was wrong. They then called the Fox back up team and quickly found out that they had mis-wired the smart meter. This was quickly corrected (although the mistake was not explained to me initially) and the system was finally commissioned at around 3.30pm.On Tuesday I received another request for payment, to which I replied that I would like to understand the problem, and fix, and to make sure that the system was indeed safe and working properly before making payment.Amazon followed up with a call on Friday where we discussed the issues in more detail, for which I am grateful.They also sent through the Electrical Safety Certificate confirming that everything had been checked and installed correctly.Since Tuesday afternoon we have been 100% self-sufficient in our electrical use. The battery is generally fully charged by around 1.30pm and we then export to the grid. Overnight the battery is discharging to somewhere between 30-50% at the moment although I expect that to increase once we start using the aircon.I am very happy with the system, and although we had a couple of issues wiht the installation, it did get resolved appropriately.Thanks Amazon Team. I am happy to recommend you to others.

Lee from Amazon Energy was great to work with, providing clear information on the system and answering questions promptly.The installation was neat, and the installer guided us on how to use the app, as well as how the wiring was laid out.Only minor issue with back and forth from administration team

My system was installed in June and has been running flawlessly since then.The ESS battery and software has been working very well and I have had a number of days in July/August where my property has been effectively off grid.The service and pricing from Amazon was above my expectations.

Best value for money for solar batteries. Got batteries with same cell as Tesla batteries but one third of a price with good warranty. Customer service, quoting and installation was very smooth. highly recommended.

I engaged Amazon Energy for my new solar-battery system because they visited me to discuss our needs on site. Having met them personally, I trusted them to do a good job, and they did. Our new 9.7 KW system and battery is working well.

Lee was very accommodating and helpful when I was choosing my solar battery and very competitive pricing.  He personally attended the site several times.The installers did the job to schedule and were very neat and efficientWould highly recommend Lee and his team

Walli at Greenultimate Broken Hill was extremely friendly when selling the product, we have had both battery and solar for over 6 months, neither have worked,. Walli never comes through, I have spoken to fair trading and will be in touch again this coming week. High alert - won't respond. Greenultimate if I could give less than 1 I would.

Got a quote for a 6.6 solar system approx 6 years ago. Friendly  people, good quote. Got system installed - it's been going good for 6 years and has not missed a beat. Rang them about a solar battery installation, very helpful, set up payment plan.System was installed 4 weeks ago, very professional installers, friendly and helped me set up app.system - it's going great no problems and will use them again for any solar systems.
Quite ok but could been better done and neater. Very sloppy. Working on install was told I would not need batteries so I now have to pay $6900 more to get batteries
Very impressed with the installation team's expertise and dedication to doing a good job.

Contact with all potential providers was good.Sales process was straight forward and clear. The selected provider, Perth Solar Force, were able to produce a system design for what I was looking for and with various rebates included the final configuration was affordable. Perth Solar Force were flexible on installation dates and the installers arrived when scheduled performed the work including the few adjustments that I had asked for when dealing with the Sales Rep. They work with me to place the battery storage in a location that met the necessary legislative and safety requirements as well as a location optimal for the household needs. They ensured the circuits I wanted in the event of a blackout would be powered by the batteries. The complete install took a couple of days for my two storey house, was not at all disruptive and provided a great end result.The Installers also ran through the operation of the system, shutdown and startup procedure, safety switches, documentation, ran through the various tests to confirm the system was fully operation for the various scenarios as designed and as required.It's only been a few weeks since installation and the system is working very well, the companion application is nice to use and informative. As to reliability I guess I see in 10-15 years time how it is still performing. If the equipment is as good quality as the installer I won't need to worry.Oh, and the cockatoo enjoyed having the installers around. I think they both found each other entertaining

Perth Solar Force's administration team have been great to deal with and were always very responsive. Whilst they are obviously very busy calls are always returned promptly with the required information shared.The install team likewise did a fantastic job and were great to deal with. I hadn't realised the amount of work involved in one of these installs and all three of them worked hard all day. The job that they did is very professional and like the top-notch tradesmen they clearly are they left a really tidy worksite once they had finished. I didn't envy them pulling cables in the roof and could hear how hard that was at times.Dealing with the sales side was also a pleasure. I am very happy with the equipment, it's ease of use and performance.I would not hesitate to recommend Perth Solar Force to anyone looking to have a solar system/battery system installed.

I had two of the three recommended companies visit our property to provide quotes. Both sales people were very professional, on time and prepared. Both provided options for our property and discussed the variables. We do have some large trees on the property which I value highly and wanted to keep, so things were not so straight forward. These trees grew to effectively block an old 2.2kW system on the garage roof and we wanted an upgrade. After many emails back and forth with both companies optimising a system, in the end I went with Perth Solar Force. They were able to supply a bigger than 10kW battery at a better price than the powerwall I was initially looking at and Tigo optimisers on each panel of a north (12 panels) and east (10 panels) facing system. Although the actual products are not in Finn’s top ten lists, they have as good a warranty as any and I was prepared to give them a go - hoping a top rated installer would not sell an inferior product. I wasn’t looking for a system with all the bells and whistles,  just something basic, reliable and would do the job.The installation team of four were on time on install day, though the weather conditions were not that favourable. Initial discussion on cabling between the house and garage, where the battery and inverter were installed, proved fruitful and together, we came up with a good solution for the conduits, which I can paint in future. I mostly left them to their own devices, just having a poke around from time to time. They did a very good job, dodging showers with battery installation, then back on the roof when showers cleared. I was left with a neat looking system on the house roof, tidy battery and inverter in the garage and the back up box installed near the main meter at the front of the house. The lead installer ran me through the basic operation of the system, shut down and start up procedures and an overview of the app used to monitor it. The system was installed and online in one day.Overall, very happy with the process from start to finish. Time will tell if the products go the distance without too many issues.

Perth Solar Force have provided exceptional service from from the initial sales enquiry to the installation and follow-up visits. Whilst I had a leak via a cracked tile following installation, all follow-up has been immediate and followed through until the leak was resolved. All of the staff who visited my premises were courteous and professional and were a pleasure to do business with.

Quoted a competitive price and they were the only company who could deliver exactly what I wanted. The installation was carried out in a timely manner and the crews were very tidy, clean and efficient. The communication was good, and they were quick to fix an issue with the app. Overall very happy with the process.

I’ve just had a GoodWe solar system put in by Perth Solar Force and I’ve been very impressed with them throughout the whole process.Presales: Glen was fantastic throughout the quoting process. With new state and federal rebates rolling out, the whole industry felt a bit chaotic—details kept changing and even some suppliers didn’t have the full picture. Glen stayed on top of it all, breaking down what incentives applied to my setup and how the timelines worked. On top of that, he fielded my mountain of “what if” scenarios and happily tweaked the proposal so I could compare options side by side. I never felt rushed, and nothing was too much trouble.Installation: The crew turned up on time, were friendly and professional, and talked me through placement options for the inverter, battery and cabling. They made sure I understood exactly what was going where and why. Bonus points for removing an old antenna and replacing a couple of cracked roof tiles that weren’t even near the array—completely unprompted.Finish: The workmanship is spoton. Conduit runs are straight, labels are clear and everything looks neat and intentional rather than “good enough.”All up, PerthSolar Force delivered a combination of expert advice, courteous installers and meticulous quality. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.
Easy. Good salesperson. Professional. Competitive. Seamless. Punctual. Installers professional and tidy and efficient.

The company responded quickly SolarQuotes notification of our interest. Their sales rep provided clear advice, responded succinctly to our questions, and didn't try to sell us something we did not want. In a nut shell, he was very professional. The quote was received the same day and immediately accepted by us. The office team kept us advised throughout the process. The install team were spot on time, friendly, skilled, and tidied up afterwards.The SAJ battery is due to be installed in July (post Gov't rebate).Going forward, a water heat pump will be the final piece of the project.

I found Electrical Masters the best company for installing solar panels and battery systems. In the past I had a small system and now we have installed 48 kw batteries for our house and it is great. Very professional and friendly staff and they do a big job in a very short time. I am happy with all the services they provide before and after the installation. Definitely 5 star from me.
Very happy with the entire process from sales till installation, will be recommending all my friends and family.

Electrical Masters recently designed and installed a new solar battery system for me and decommissioned my old system, and I couldn’t be happier with the entire experience.  From start to finish, their team was friendly, professional, polite, and incredibly supportive. They were always on time and remained patient and understanding- even when my neglected, overly messy garage caused delays on my end.I worked with Jay Lakota and one of my biggest reliefs was how he and his team handled all the government forms and paperwork it was an absolute godsend and took a huge weight of my shoulders.Having first commissioned solar in 2010 - a process that was a complete nightmare - I am beyond grateful that I chose Electrical Masters this time round. The difference in quality, communication and care was night and day.  I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and capable team for their solar needs.

We're very happy that we used SolarQuotes to kick start our battery journey, it made the process so simple.  Three quotes from local installers, all were quick to make contact. Calls and quotes the following day, we then did further research with links and more information they provided. Over the weekend we decided to change what we wanted, we sent emails to the installers and they quickly provided updated quotes.  Quotes accepted one day and battery installed the next. Installers were very professional and polite, after install they helped explain how the system worked and setting up the App. Tidied up afterwards. Very happy with result.

The team where friendly, informative and know the solar market well compared to a lot of retailers who are just there for the sale. The installation team were great and even managed to turn around the inspection before go-live very quickly!
Very good service and price was great as well as the quick turn around thanks you so much guys.
A bit more notice before installation  would have been nice.Pestered to leave a review even before battery was turned on !!!

The quote process was easy and quick with quotes provided efficiently. The team were very punctual, very polite and helpful with site assessment and discussing the viable options for installation of battery. The team members were experts in their specialism and provided indepth information about the use and installation. We highly recommend the agency for their expertise in the field, punctuality and making us at ease during the whole process.

The sale and quoting process was smooth. Electrical Masters offered a very competitive price for the battery installation. The installation team was knowledgeable and punctual . The work was tidy with clear labels for the system.The customer service was good with regular updates. Jay Lalit offered good customer service and coordinated the whole process. Ali offered technical advice for the installation.The grid connection was organised within a week of installation. The company assisted with the grid connection.

If you’re reading this review because you’re considering the services of Electrical Masters, then my opinion is that you would definitely be impressed with what this company offers.I recently decided to purchase a storage battery and whilst I knew the basics, there was a lot that I didn’t know but wanted to be informed about. I’d previously used SolarQuotes for my Solar panels and that was a good experience, so was confident that they would be able to refer me to 3 trustworthy retailers – an important consideration given that there will be plenty of cowboys with inferior products out there trying to take advantage of the Government Battery Rebate Scheme.Referral led me to Electrical Masters who responded within hours of me requesting a quote. First contact was from Jas who explained the whole process, went into depth on what the various batteries are capable of, asked me what we wanted to achieve and what our goals were. Importantly, through his explanations he was able to provoke questions from me that consequently gave me a great understanding of the product and process, including the finer details of location of unit and installation. Being better informed and between Jas and I, we were able to decide on what the best option would be for us. Jas’ knowledge of their products and his ability to communicate and empathise were first class and gave me the confidence to know I was dealing with the right people. I was given a very competitive quote on the day and after speaking with the other Retailers was very comfortable with my decision to go with Electrical Masters.Following on from this, I received a site visit from Ricky, the company owner, to discuss Battery location – I’d had a possible change of thought. After discussion location was decided on. Through additional discussion, I was extremely impressed with Ricky’s attitude to his business, staff and products, which again reinforced my confidence that I’d made the right decision.Installation time was arranged very quickly (timing is everything!) and Installers Jaswinder and Harry arrived on site as expected and did excellent installation job, cleaned up and removed all packaging and mess. The boys were very friendly, ensured the system was up and running and connected to both Manufacturer’s and my Home’s Networks. They took the time to show me how the App works and whilst I’m still getting a handle on my battery’s capabilities, confidence is growing within days.I purchased a Sigenergy SigenStor  24kWh Battery and highly recommend it and Electrical Masters the Supplier.

I couldn't be happier with our recent solar and battery installation from Electrical Masters. The entire process was seamless, professional, and delivered exceptional results.A huge shout-out to the installation team:Daniel & Team did an amazing job installing the panels. He ensured we achieved the maximum possible installation on the roof space, which is already translating into fantastic performance. His work ethic and attention to detail were first-rate.Beau's professionalism was outstanding during the installation of the battery and gateway. His neatness, knowledge, and dedication to ensuring everything was commissioned perfectly was truly impressive.It's clear that the Electrical Masters team takes great pride in their work. Highly recommend them for a top-quality system and a stress-free installation!

I struggled to get someone to come out and view the property. Electrical masters sent someone. They helped choose the best place for the battery that worked for me and satisfied regulations. They adjusted as I learnt and worked to my needs. Price was best by far, grid connected and they answer the phone when I call. Not much more to add.

Electrical Masters provided a well designed battery solution including a gateway to allow full operation of the system in off-grid mode.The quote provided was signficantly cheaper then others for exactly the same equipment.There was a reasonable delay between deposit and installation but this was due to supply of battery components rather than installers.The installers were on time and the installation was very neat and the site was left tidy afterwards. Intially there was a compatibility issue between the existing soalr panel inverter (SolarEdge) and the new battery system (SigEnergy). Electrical Masters spoke to both technical teams and were able to resolve the issue within 48 hours. The SigEnergy app is brilliant and gives your full visibility and control over the system operation.I'd highly recommend Electrical Masters as a battery system installer.

I recently had Electrical Masters install a home battery system. Their initial pricing wasn’t the clearest, but they were open to negotiation and I was able to secure a very good deal in the end.The installation itself was quick and efficient, though I did have to step in and clarify parts of the quoted scope with the installers on the day. To their credit, once those details were confirmed, the team got on with the job and delivered the system as promised. A small fault cropped up shortly after commissioning, but their support team responded promptly and had it resolved the next business day.Overall, Electrical Masters delivered a very good deal, fast installation, and excellent fault resolution. While there’s room for improvement in communication between quoting and installation, I’d still highly recommend them to others considering a home battery system.

Electrical Masters can be trusted. I got the best quote in town that came with top/good quality solar panels and battery. They accomodate to my request for delay in installation for about a month. The solar panels were upgraded without additional cost when the solar panel company rolled out the latest all black panels before the installation. The installation team especially the technician head were polite and efficient.Can’t wait for the inspection to be done (system installed yesterday) and start to see the savings in my energy bill.

Electrical Masters recently installed a solar battery system at my home, and the whole process—from quote to installation—was very fast and smooth. The installation team were professional and took the time to ensure the site was suitable and the job was done neatly. Communication with Electrical Masters was easy throughout. I’m very happy with the quality of their work and the overall experience. Highly recommended!
Good process, was a little long all things said and done, but most of this was resulting from initial delays on my end. Great customer service and strong follow ups.

Had Electrical Masters install my Sigenergy battery system. The installation was finished nicely and clean, and I’m happy with the result. Jass from the sales team was very helpful and patient with all my questions. Internal communication could be smoother, but overall it was a good experience.

I had a great experience with The Electrical Masters from start to finish. Jay explained the system options clearly and made sure it was tailored to my needs. When the original battery wasn’t available, they organised an alternative at a similar price. The installation team was polite, on time, and left everything neat and tidy. They showed me how to configure the mobile app, however I am still waiting for the grid connection to be completed. In all, couldn’t have asked for better service.

I had a 6.6kW solar system installed by Electrical Masters last month, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience.From the start, the team explained the system clearly and answered all my questions without any pressure. The quoting process was transparent and easy to understand.The installation itself was done professionally and on time. The installers were friendly, efficient, and left the site clean and tidy. Since installation, everything has worked exactly as expected. I've been able to track the system’s performance easily, and it's already making a noticeable difference to our energy usage. I would highly recommend Electrical Masters to anyone considering solar – professional, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to deal with from start to finish.
Entire process was amazing, I’m enjoying the product to the max. Thanks Electrical Masters for a complete package, good customer service and high levels of professionalism

Terrific service from admin side to the installing side, communication was spot on and even the prices were good.I recommend Electrical Masters for all your solar and battery needs.Thanks again Electrical Masters for installing my solar and looking after me.
Quick and nice installationFriendly and helpful staffMuch recommended
Had a very smooth and quick process to install solar panels for my home. Good customer service .

Sales/Quoting, I was asked in detail about what I wanted. I was given the opportunity to change the details of the quote. A detailed quote was provided and the details explained.Installation was polite, tidy and punctual. There was co-ordination with our plumber and other contractors to install a water pipe in the trench from the house to the shed (as per Australian standards. Material quality appears excellent. I had a 32.2kWh SiG battery system installed to my 14.8 kwh existing solar panels in mid-April 2025 this year. While the battery itself has performed reliably, the sales experience has been deeply disappointing and dishonest.During the consultation, the salesperson, sold me a 10kWh 3-phase inverter without conducting any proper assessment of my household’s energy usage or load profile.At no stage did they ask about my major appliances, including the single-phase reverse-cycle air conditioner, or explain the limitations of a 3-phase inverter when it comes to powering single-phase loads.After complete installation, I noticed that despite having ample of stored battery power, my AC would continue drawing 1.32kWh from the grid when in use. Through several escalations, a senior manager eventually visited and confirmed the issue: the 3-phase 10 Kwh inverter could not supply enough current amps on a single phase to run the AC, forcing the system to draw from the grid—even though the battery was full.Despite admitting this issue, the company offered no concessions or try to sell this and offer the upgrade. I was told they are not responsible for checking customers’ load configurations. While I understand that customers bear some responsibility to understand their systems, a basic discussion about appliance compatibility and system suitability should be standard in the sales process, especially when selling to customers without any electrical background.Sales seemed more focused on closing the sale for commission than offering a tailored solution.Now, four months after installation, I’m facing the cost of upgrading to a 15kWh 3-phase inverter, which multiple independent solar companies have confirmed should have at least been recommended in the first place.To the SolarQuotes team. I respectfully ask that this review remain published in full. This is an honest account of my experience and I believe it’s important for other homeowners to be aware of potential pitfalls when dealing with sales people from this installer. While the SiG battery itself is a great product, the lack of due diligence during the sales process was extremely poor.

review_description: First up i would like to say i have never experienced 3 separate groups of tradespeople call me quickly, arrange for on site quotes and actually show up within days of being requested for a quote. Normally i am chasing tradies for weeks to get them to show up for quotes, It was a very pleasant experience getting my 3 quotes thanks to SolarQuotes.Right from the initial quoting process the company I went with, Sunlogics,  was a stand out. The person who came out to quote actually got up on my roof and had a good look, fully explained the need for optimisers with the amount of shade on my roof and explained how they worked. They explained the need for some minor works on my switchboard to accommodate the system. Neither of the other two companies who quoted got up on the roof, only one mentioned the need for optimisers, that company also noted the need for some minor works on my switchboard. The third company didn't even look at my switchboard.Sunlogics payment requirements were also reasonable, 20% deposit, balance within 15 days of invoice issue at the end of the project. The other company that was in the same ballpark price and system spec wise, basically wanted 50% payment up front, and the balance paid before installation or at the latest on the day of installation. Needless to say i wasn't doing business with them.The install crew were very professional, kept us informed throughout the process as to what was happening and showed up when they said they would. They left the site spotless after they were finished. The install ran over due to some difficulties they had getting cabling through my tight roof space, but they were able to complete the work early the next business day. They ran me through the system and made sure i was comfortable with the process for switching to backup power from the battery in the event of a power failure, and explained to me how the system works, powering the house first, battery second, then feeding the grid. They showed me how the monitoring app worked.They made what looked like a daunting process on paper a seamless and painless process from start to finish.

Scott at Solar Power Panels was one 10+ quotes I obtained for my system. He is professional, communicative and informative. A conversation with him was enough to make me feel confident that I've found the right person for the job. He was able to tailor a suitable system with the features I was looking for while offering it at a competitive price. He also seemed thoughtful in figuring out the right system for me, providing me with valuable industry insights to anticipate any issues, potential shortfalls and realistic expected performance of the system. The other reviews I read from previous customers only further solidified my decision to proceed with this company.The installers were also punctual and friendly. Installation took approximately 5.5 hours and they gladly answered any questions I had on the day and ensured I was comfortable with how the system runs.I'd readily recommend Scott to any friends and family who are looking to install solar panels and batteries as I know they'll be in good hands.

I engaged Link Solar to deliver a new Solar panels and battery system. I found Christian to be very professional and took time to answer a number of questions I had to ensure I was comfortable in making a decision. I found Christian to be very knowledgeable and at no stage felt pressured to proceed. After confirming acceptance to purchase I found the communication of very high quality and understood exactly the steps being conducted and timelines. The installation teams were friendly and very efficient and cleaned up the site after finishing. Max when installing found an issue with the switchboard cabinet that had been there for many years and could have been harmful if it had not been detected. This high-level of diligence produced a very high-quality outcome for the installed system. The install team took time to explain the setup and what would happen at different points of the timeline. Christian contacted me shortly after to confirm next steps and the relevant points of contact for the Sigenerygy battery. Having recently installed I am more than pleased with the performance of the Aiko Solar panels and battery. The professionalism, communication and high-quality customer service shown by Link Solar has impressed me and I highly recommend Link Solar to other people looking to purchase a system.

The sales/quoting process was very quick and multiple install variants were provided.We selected the 12Kw system with a 19Kw capacity battery.The panels and inverter were installed 2 weeks after deposit was made, they were awaiting restock of the battery provided in quote. Installer team were professional and did decent work. Majority of trade waste was collected and disposed of. The running of cabling throughout roof space was done satisfactorily and installer provided photo's of roof penetration points and weatherproofing applied.Grid connection was setup by the company quickly and promptly and we were up and running on solar same day as install.Following Panel/Inverter install I received 0 updates about status of the restock of the battery. After requesting an update, we were asked to wait a few days for an answer. 2 weeks later we were provided with an alternative battery to be installed and price difference (more expensive) was covered by Sungold Solar.from time of deposit accepted to time of battery installed was 8 weeks. Battery was installed by the installer and connected correctly and working. I had concerns with single insulated cables to the battery (plug is waterproof) but still exposed to afternoon UV. An unacceptable amount of trade waste remained at battery install site (dropped silicone, wire clippings etc.) and the warning labels stuck to the brick wall were secured with a small dab of silicone.I requested the installers return to site to rectify the trade waste, which they did 6 days later apologising for the trade waste that remained left over. I asked the installer to give me a quick explanation on how to isolate the battery/panels if I require to do so in the future, which they did.I plan on rectifying the warning labels myself (place onto a Perspex board and secure to the wall) and install a sun cover over the single insulated leads to protect from UV. I also plan on double insulating the leads running up to the battery myself with vulcanising tape and Denso.Overall i am satisfied with the product even with some of the issues encountered throughout the process (trade waste, having to prompt for an update).

Electrifying Australia is a very considerate Company to deal with. We were told how to operate the system before the installer left.We are most pleased and excited about our purchase and highly recommend Electrifying Australia to prospective buyers.

I'm very happy with the performance of the new solar and battery system. The project moved quickly, completing in only a few weeks. Noah deserves a big shout-out for his exceptional service. I now have a Sigenergy 3 Phase 15KW Hybrid Inverter with 10KW of panels, 32KWh of battery and a Gateway providing full house backup. It’s been a very technical journey to find the right solution for our needs. Maha from Electrifying Australia was very responsive with providing options and responding to the changes I requested. I think my needs where somewhat new for them as I have a Clipsal C-Bus 3 Phase house setup meaning that full house backup was the only real solution. Then came the challenge of the shortage of supply due to the battery rush. Maha offered other options, but I stuck with the Sig option and accepted the November install date (quoted in September). The system was live on the 4th of November.The installation process went well and the team where good to work with and happy to support our requirements. The main challenge was the weather, either getting too hot to work on the roof or raining causing the installation to take longer than expected. The design was also tuned during the installation process (changing the distribution of panels across the north and east sides of the roof).Why did I go with Electrifying Australia:-	They are responsive,-	Their advice made sense and are open to exploring different options,-	Price was good,-	The others failed to respond when they said, proposed things that did not make sense, quoted on products they where not using on their own home (they were installing Sigenergy at home but suggesting something different for me without a good reason), and quoted a higher price.I would do it again - Yes.The one thing I did not realise was how much heat a 15KW inverter creates. I now have a heater in my garage. Something to keep in mind for people thinking about installing solar.

The sales and quoting process was clear and straightforward, with helpful advice on system options. Zac and his team installed the panels and inverter in no time, even on a very hot day. They organised the grid connection, followed up to ensure everything was working.Overall, I’m very happy with the system and would gladly recommend them.

Talk to friends and family about their experience with good, reputable suppliers/installers. review_description: RAW Power and Lighting were very efficient and called me immediately to provide a quote. Whilst I was not looking for the cheapest system they ended up providing me with a top quality set up at a very affordable price. They were very helpful from the start and the whole thing was finished within three weeks. Very courteous guys doing the install and everything was left tidy at the end. They were more than happy to explain how it all works and at this stage I couldn't be happier. I would highly recommend them to others.

Ryan was great with communication and information needed for us to decide on the right system.  Installation went smoothly.  Guys cleaned up well.  Nic organised everything for us - so very stress free!  Would totally recommend RAW Power and Lighting.  In fact, we are getting further electrical work soon with this company.
Simple quotation to understand. Answered questions well. Timely. Think I’ll be happy with the system when it’s finally up and running.
Raw power and lighting were great. Easy to deal with, efficient and pleasant to deal with. Happy with my solar.

RAW Power and Lighting did an outstanding job installing my solar system. The workmanship was top quality, with every detail finished to a really high standard. What impressed me just as much was their flexibility — not only did they take care of the solar installation, but they were also happy to tackle a few other jobs around the house at the same time, which made the whole process so much easier for me.The team was professional, reliable, and great to deal with from start to finish. I’d highly recommend RAW Power and Lighting to anyone looking for skilled electricians who go above and beyond for their customers.

Initial sales service and helping me work out what I wanted was excellent - I got exactly what I wanted from that process with a lot of advice and support along the way for a very competitive price. Very knowledgableInstallation was... not great.* I had serious amounts of concrete dust/debris left inside the house, ceiling cavity and outside from installing the brackets on my concrete tile roof. Only partially remedied when they vacuumed out the easily accessible third of my roof space - but then left the rest.* I have some split rafters from them not pre-drilling before driving pretty large screws into them for the brackets.* I had a couple of cracked tiles discovered underneath some of the solar panels (on a freshly restored roof) that neither the solar installer or roofer was willing to take responsibility for. But the installer did want to charge me for a full day's work to come and remove/replace 2 panels so I could get those tiles replaced. They are on the Gold Coast, I am in Toowoomba. No allowances made for their potential culpability until I fought it.I gave up and some items remain un-raised and unaddressed. It was exhausting having to fight them on everything to get anything fixed. Very poor customer service in that regard.Electrically I have no idea. I am unqualified and could not tell you if what I got is up to scratch. To a layman, it looks good.Grid connection and setup for monitoring was excellent. I didn't have to do a thing there.All in all - I really hope that my system stands the test of time and just keeps working for me so that I don't have to deal with the installer again.

Raw’s customer rep, Ryan was amazing at keeping me informed and taking me through all the options, despite me having a million questions. I never felt pressured to sign on with them like other companies, and as they have a small team I knew who was going to be responsible for the install. When talking with others about when they had solar installed they’d often say that they had no after installation follow up. But Raw took time to call me back on a Saturday morning to see how things were going and give me an update.

Quoting and install was all quick, efficient, genuine and user friendly. There was an issue with the hot water timer and they came back the same day I called to let them know. The service to ensure it was fixed was incredible.

Ryan was a font of knowledge and the conversation was easy to follow, very informative, and I felt no pressure.I was very pleased with the quote.  I had gathered four quotes in all and Raw Power and Lighting was the 2nd cheapest, but I felt most comfortable going with them.Nic and his team arrived at the agreed time and were professional and tidy.  The hybrid inverter set-up is neat and tidy.  Nic showed me how to use the app (very easy) to view how much power was being generated by the panels/ how much power was being used by the household/ how much power was going back to the grid etc.Everything with the energy supplier was organised for me by Raw.  I don't think the whole process could have been any easier.
The whole process from sale to after sales was super simple and fast. The staff were friendly and helpful. Very happy with Aussie Solar Batteries.
Totally professional team with above and beyond customer service. These guys know their  business and deliver the goods. So glad I chose SJ Power for my installation. Highly recommend.

Fantastic team from the start, after being contacted by Clare the office manager and asking a few questions and getting pictures to arranging site visit with Shea the owner to the install team I could not ask for anything more, they was on time, polite, and tidy.After the install they gave me a run of how the system works with instructions and APP monitoring, after install Clare followed up and completed final paperwork for grid connection with no hassle or stress, .

I decided to go with SJ Power and can say that thier service was 100% from day one to the completed installation and beyond. The intial meeting was very helpful and detailed everything I needed that will suit the already installed solar panels, then the crew that worked on the installation were outstanding, kept me up to date on their progress and took me through all details once completed. Help me out installing and understanding the app to monitor the solar and batteries performance, they also came back a couple of days later to sort out some annomalies they had found. Very helpful and I'm very pleased with the results

I first installed solar panels with them and didn’t hesitate to contact them again when I decided to add a battery and EV charger. The team was professional, efficient, and knowledgeable from start to finish.Hannah, the sales manager, took the time to explain everything clearly, adjusted the quotes to fit my budget, and genuinely listened to my needs. Claire ensured smooth communication throughout the process, making everything seamless. A big thanks to Ethan and the installation team for their excellent work and their professional, polite communication.And thank you, Shae  for leading such a great team, that’s why I like to support local businesses like yours. The customer support is also excellent: if you have any issues with your system, you’ll be promptly and reliably assisted.Highly recommend SJ Power to anyone looking for expert, trustworthy solar installation,

Sales person was friendly and helpful, took time to answer my questions. Came in person to visit and quote (other companies did not). No high pressure sales techniques. On the day the installation was on time, efficient, clean. No issues. App connection sorted on the day.

Salesman was great - agreed to everything. We have a tricky house, but everything was doable. We signed a contract and paid deposit in April.A second person came to inspect - said the house was tricky but all was fine.Install date was September. The installers arrived and felt the job was tricky. They didn't want to install that day.We received a call from Solaire later that day saying the job was tricky and they weren't going to do it as it would cost us more than it's worth. I asked for them to provide a revised quote.They emailed saying that they weren't going to do the job and would refund the deposit. I have asked for a proper reason and they have not replied. I asked for them to refund deposit plus interest and they have not replied.This is breach of the contract.We now have no idea why it's tricky to install and we are struggling to find another contractor to do the job - we signed up in April to beat the rush only to be screwed over.
The whole process from first home visit to discuss options to follow up, subsequent questions through to installation went very smoothly. Really pleased with the outcome.

Sales rep was responsive, but didn’t provide additional relevant information unless specifically asked or missed info that I discovered later on from Synergy. The installation itself was neat and carried out by a friendly team, though some miscommunication meant I had to follow up afterwards for operational settings for charging from the grid.

Excellent and seamless process start to finish. No damage to roof tiles either very impressive. Supplied additional tiles in the event of and left them with very kind. Complex install of using 5 seperate sections of the roof, so as to maximize solar panel exposure very professional

Contact from sales was quick and easy after seeking advice from Finn. Neil was fantastic. Great induction to solar for newbies, and many simple early answers to our many questions.Quote received quickly, lots of post advice resulted in our choice to seek system flexibility.Install was completed in a day, with a two week lead time. Cade and the team were very professional, including relevant checks and certification. Electrical cert and follow up with Synergy, all completed via Nicolle in the office. Even assessed and returned to reposition a panel, to improve the solar systems performance.Overall a Great Experience. Thanks to All.

I couldn’t be happier with my  solar installation. The team was professional, punctual, and highly knowledgeable. From the initial consultation to the final switch-on, the process was seamless and stress-free. They took the time to explain the system, tailored the setup to suit my energy needs, and ensured all paperwork and approvals were handled efficiently. I’m already seeing the benefits on my electricity bill. Highly recommend this company to anyone considering solar!

We recently had a 19kW solar system installed by Capital Valley Solar, including a SMA inverter and a Stiebel Eltron heat pump. From the initial consultation to the final installation, the entire experience was smooth and professional.Kam from CVS was outstanding—his technical knowledge is impressive, and he clearly explained every step of the process. He was always available to answer our questions and made sure we understood how to get the most out of our system.The communication throughout the project was excellent, and more importantly, the job was completed on time, with no surprises or delays.We are very happy with the quality of work and the products installed. We highly recommend Capital Valley Solar to anyone looking for a reliable and knowledgeable solar installer in Canberra.
We were extremely satisfied with the entire process of our solar installation from initial contact, advice given, punctuality & workmanship. Thank you Paramount!

Paramount were recomended by Solar Quotes and a friend who had dealt with them. The entire process was stress free. They kept us informed throughout the process including a two day delay in installation due to severe storms in SE Qld.

From start to finish Pure electric provided best in class service.As someone that had 0 knowledge of solar and battery technology and blasé with our own power consumption, we have been shown the way of the future with Pure electrics experience.Everything ran smoothly and also ahead of quoted time. Flexible with solar array location and giving best system advice for full home backup.Experienced first grid outage recently and did not even notice a flicker or have internet drop out.

Tom provided a very detailed quote and came out to our site to check everything out before installation. Answered all of our questions arranged for old solar hot water panels and evaporative cooler to be removed.Installation. went smoothly. Tradesmen arrived on time. Explained all work. Set up and Showed me how to use the Tesla app for the battery.Organized grid connection and all paperwork. Checked the system is working from their end and even recommended a retailer with the highest feed in tariff. Worksite left clean and tidy.

I use the AGL sungrow bundle as upper limit (6.6kw PV + 9.6kwh battery for 16500 based in SA) to compare with the quotes I received. Using the same sungrow components, most of the quotes are similar to AGL. I have only a few quotes came back with "reasonable" price. I checked the reviews from SolarQuotes + Google, and decided to go with Greenaus.Through the first phone call to the end of the installation. I can say I have no regret. John was prompt and professional in there approach to the job at hand. John only lives 10 minutes away and said if I have any problems just give him a ring.

review_description: I had a good experience with my MyEnergy installation and had recommended to a couple of friends. Their service team is yet to acknowledge a single email and despite calling and being promised a call back - nothing. Would not recommend now, I feel like my warranty is worthless without a decent service department backing it up.
The whole procedure is easy to follow up and great customer service

The sales and quoting process was clear, efficient, and well-explained, with all technical details and costs presented transparently.The installation was carried out punctually and to a high standard. The team assisted with the grid connection process after installation and provided clear guidance on system operation, including the use of the charger.Overall, the project was delivered smoothly and professionally, with all aspects meeting a high standard.

Really happy with my new solar and battery setup. The quoting process was simple and straightforward, no pushy sales tactics, just clear info. The installers showed up on time, were super polite, and left everything neat and tidy. After the install, the team walked me through the app and even sorted out the grid connection, which saved me a lot of hassle. The Anker Solix 30kWh battery has been running smoothly and I’m already seeing the benefits. Definitely recommend!
Great product, professional skill, nice customer services and very genius people
Good service and beatiful productI can easy manage the system by app

We engaged MyEnergy Group to install our new Anker Solix X1 6kW / 20kWh battery at Southwest Sydney, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. The sleek grey matte finish looks incredible in the space, but with limited wall area, it was a tricky installation.Jeff from MyEnergy Group took the time to visit our home, walk through different layout options, and find a design that worked within the constraints, all while ensuring full compliance. The team from Avery Solar and Electrical from the outset of Chris visiting our site preparing a system and quote for our needs have been exemplary. They have been polite and have handled all aspects of the installation in an upmost and professional manner. I can highly recomend this company.

Very happy so far with our dealing with Avery. They responded to our request quickly, asked for enough information to tailor the quote to our needs and installed the battery in a much shorter timeframe than the other suppliers we contacted. The battery is up and running and our grid usage is down to zero.

Avery Solar and Electrical was no doubt the best decision we made when we chose an installer for our solar.Great communication from start to finish, the installers were on time and extremely professional, they did an outstanding job and took away the old panels and all the rubbish.I could not be happier, they were outstanding.
Very professional and easy process..should have done it years ago

review_description: Buying solar and a battery is a big deal! It's basically the third biggest purchase you make after a house and a car. From my first chats with Patrick I knew PTE solar were the people for the job. He knows his stuff and and it really put me at ease.Patrick and his wife came up with a competitive quote and kept me well informed in the run up to the build. My battery had to be installed quite far from my meter box due to safety regulations, and they did a very neat job with cabling and conduit which I really appreciated.Patrick and his very polite PTE team seemed like they'd been working together for some time and I was very impressed with their work ethic over the course of the day.The system looks to be performing very well, and I've not used any grid power in the week that it's been installed.Keep up the good work and I'll be recommending PTE solar to friends and family.

review_description: For anyone looking into solar — especially with battery systems these days — it can be quite overwhelming. There are so many options, technical details, and decisions to make. I really appreciate how Patrick took the time to walk me through everything, explaining what system would best suit my needs and the pros and cons of different setups.He helped me understand the differences between single-phase and three-phase systems, full and partial backup options, and where each dollar is going. I adjusted the system size several times, asked for multiple quotes, and even switched brands during the process — and Patrick remained incredibly patient, responsive, and transparent throughout. He’s a straight shooter who sets clear expectations, which I really value.The installation itself was very smooth and well-organised. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and completed the installation by early afternoon. They also communicated clearly about the placement of the equipment, walked me through the steps, and helped set up the monitoring system afterward.Overall, I’m very happy with both the system and the service. The installation quality is excellent, and the pricing is very competitive. I highly recommend Patrick and the PTE Solar team to anyone considering a solar and battery setup.
company_name: PTE Solar and Electrical Pty Ltd

review_description: Bronson was fantastic during the sales and quoting for our panels and battery. He explained everything clearly and answered some follow up questions I had promptly and made it easy to understand the system and expected outcomes. He organised the paperwork for the rebates and for Synergy which was a great help.  The guys doing the install were on time, efficient, polite and cleaned up any mess before leaving. They assisted with the app and how to best use the system. The new system is working great. I would highly recommend Unplugged Energy for anyone looking for solar panels and a battery.

Excellent service from Unplugged Energy. All my questions were answered very promptly, and they provided recommendations based on exactly what I was looking for. I especially appreciated that they even offered cheaper alternatives that would still meet my needs.The installation was exceptional. The unit looks fantastic, and the entire work area was left spotless, thanks Justin, Dylan and Matt. Justin walked me through the system's operation, showed me the switchboard, and even asked me which parts of the house I wanted connected to the backup battery in case of a power outage.All in all, this was a fantastic experience, and I highly recommend Unplugged Energy.

Solar and battery system installed with Unplugged Energy. The whole process, including navigating the rebates and the communication around it was very easy. The installing crew was very thorough, efficient and cleaned up after themselves.

I recently had Unpugged Energy quoted and install a solar battery, rewire my old circuit board, replace the inverter, and test the entire system - and I couldn’t be happier! My house had an outdated electrical setup, requiring them to rearrange and upgrade everything, but JT, Tuong, and Nick handled it with expertise and patience.They were hands-on, professional, and friendly, answering all my questions thoroughly. Despite working in cold, windy conditions, they never cut corners and even went above and beyond by fixing a tile leakage on my roof and giving a gutter clean - something I truly appreciate!Big credit to this hardworking, skilled team—they made the entire process smooth and stress-free. Highly recommended for anyone needing solar or electrical work. Thanks again, Nick, Tuong and JT!

I recently had a solar battery system installed through All Australian Energy, and the entire experience was excellent from start to finish. Jayden and Mateo were fantastic to deal with—professional, helpful, and patient as they guided me through selecting the correct system for my home. They made the whole process clear and straightforward, and I really appreciated their honest advice.On installation day, Ben and his team arrived on time and got straight to work. Their workmanship was clean and efficient, and they took the time to walk me through how everything operated once the system was up and running. The installation was completed to a very high standard, and the system has been performing perfectly.Overall, I’m extremely happy with both the product and the service. I highly recommend All Australian Energy, as well as Jayden, Mateo, Ben, and the installation team, for anyone considering solar and battery solutions.

The AAE team were great from start to finish. They were very helpful with determining the best fit for purpose system for my needs and were courteous, prompt and very competitive with quoting.The install team were fantastic at communicating when they would be on site and very efficient at getting the work done. The job site was left clean and tidy when they left.
Quoting process was a mission.Installers were professionals, very tidy and efficient, overall excellent job.

Custom Solar Power responded quickly and arranged a home inspection straight away. Michael arrived well-prepared with all the details about my existing solar setup and explained how a solar battery would work, keeping it simple, which I really appreciated, as I find the technical specs very overwhelming. Communication was great throughout, and I was kept up to date with the installation schedule. The team was punctual, tidy, and did a very neat job. They also showed me how to use the charger in an easy-to-understand way. Very happy with the service, professional, efficient, and friendly!

Custom Solar Power was great from start to finish. Zaren was more than happy to answer all my questions about the system without a fuss.You can get a cheaper install elsewhere but you'll pay for it in half a decade. The installation was phenomenal, extremely clean and tidy and really quick considering everything.I'd recommend these lads to anybody if you want a premium install and peace of mind.

Cant give CSP team enough praise, best quoting process, best quote, best installation, best after installation customer service.All CSP staff are enthusiastic and committed to providing the best product and service to support your energy needs. I had additional solar panels and battery installed, they were punctual, quick, neat and happy to show me how my system worked.The CSP developed software to assist with selling power to the grid is exceptional.  Their support with my learning curve was and is highly admirable.

The whole process from sales to installation and commissioning was professional and efficient. They were patient and informative answering many questions and revising my quote quite a few times as I changed my mind on equipment. Installers were great, did a tidy job, and fullfilled all of my requests regarding installation specifics like inverter location, cabling routes, moved a conduit I realised would clash with future works without fuss. They then ran me through everything once commissioned and made sure I had the monitoring app working. System was up and running 100% the day installation was completed, this was instantly reflected in our metered usage the next day. Exceeded expectations and I feel confident about receiving ongoing support should it be required. 100% will be my first call when I want a battery, which can be added very easily now because CSP correctly rationalised the additional cost of a hybrid inverter in the initial solar only installation, the system is already setup for backup which means the battery is virtually a plug in addition and also comes with the benifit of excellent monitoring via the app as the whole house load now runs through the inverter, regardless of if it's pulling from solar or grid.

Initially communication was poor with install date being pushed back and installer not arriving on time. These difficulties were mainly due to factors affecting the battery industry generally outside of Custom Solar Power's control.The installed solution's integrations weren't to my expectation, but CSP then worked hard to provide a solution that I was happy with and continue to work with me until 3rd party integrations are working. The unmet expectations were due to factors outside of CSPs control.Zaren went above and beyond to help customise my solution to what I wanted and continues to be helpful well after the initial install.
Sales/quoting was direct and positiveInstallation went punctual and tidyCustomer service is excellent

Zarren, MD of Custom Solar Power, was very helpful and friendly when he came onsite to quote for our system. He was thorough in explaining the various options available to us and the process and cost involved for each option. (We had spoken to 3 other installers prior to CSP - none had Zarren's in-depth knowledge of the solar industry and his expertise.)On the day of installation, the team arrived on time, and were efficient, polite and professional. The installation process went very smoothly; on completion the team leader explained how the inverter worked and helped to install the app onto my iPad. Indeed, from start to finish it was a seamless experience - I highly recommend Zarren and the CSP team.

Hardware: batteries + new hybrid inverter (Sungrow/Sungrow), Solar panel expansion (Aiko), additional dongle for remote power trading control.Sales/quote: performed an onsite inspection, answered all my questions (I kept thinking of more), and gave thoughtful considerations to all my requests and suggestions (around waste, recycling, panel placement, priorities for environmental impact vs cost efficiency, future proofing, EV expansions - I have a difficult site). Provided quotes in a timely manner, provided all data sheets and warranties for me to peruse. They were realistic about what I could expect, and accommodated my requests. Provided a variety of options for hardware, and for energy provider set ups.Install: Timely, friendly and polite, well resourced with knowledgeable staff on site, put in an extra light in my dark little shed, tidied up everything after. Took away old equipment. Changed over my hot water system (from off peak).Customer service: Answered extra questions and confirmed my preferences again on the day of the install. Performed grid connection. Talked me through different components, switches and trouble shooting and then provided me with photos along with instruction manual. They sent follow up emails to make sure I was happy and everything was working well. They were also careful to time their connections/contracts/install to ensure I was taking advantage of the battery rebate.Energy trading: They set up a dongle and helped me assign them permission to trade on my behalf. They set up sensible initial parameters for battery and AEMO spot price trading decisions. I didn't realise that they would be in touch again - but they emailed me to let me know when my inverter connection had cut out, then called me soon after to follow up and make sure I'd been able to fix it, and then rediscussed my energy usage, and made plans to tweak their algorithm to make my trading efficiency even better. They micro manage for me, but there is flexibility if I want to change things manually, and I can watch everything in the Sungrow app.Based on their recommendations, management, and installation, I am approximately $600-700 better off per quarter than I was before with Origin energy as a provider, no battery, and a smaller panel array. By bill for the first 29 days was -$59.35. 2 months after the installation, and they are about to tighten up the trading parameters based on my data so far.

The quoting service showed a lot of patience with my detailed requests and changes in specificationsThe installation was very professional and the finish looks neat and cleanThe whole process was excellent from first contact to finished product
Resinc have delivered what they've told us at the beginning. It's a quality product and overall it's been an easy experience. The solar panels also looks great on the roof

Resinc have great service, an easy installation process, great communication and everything went so smoothly. We are very happy after going solar with Resinc!
We’re happy with our solar and glad these guys come out every year to help us with our bills and find better plans that help us maximise our solar, even after two and a half years.

I feel like every aspect of the process has been great, the install went really smoothly, no issues with that. Now that we’ve got a battery, our bills look even better, and it’s worked really well for us.
The customer service has been really good and made the whole process easy.
