Everything from sale to install and in between has been amazing. We have a system with a battery and are looking forward to seeing how it impacts our bills. If you’re going to go solar, I would recommend it, but I recommend it even more if you choose to install it with Resinc.

Everyone has been very helpful and friendly. I haven't had any issues since installation. I think it's great that if the system would go down for any reason, Resinc is monitoring the system. I can also use the app to see how much solar we are producing.
The system is working fine and we have been very satisfied over the last two years. Glad they send people out to check in on things.
We have had the system for 5 years. Our bills used to be $650 per quarter, once we installed we got $750 in credit! We were able to pay the system off. We have had a great experience.

I’ve had no need to contact them myself, and I absolutely recommend them to anyone thinking of getting a solar system.
12 months of $0 bills since installing! We are really happy with the install & happy with our decision!

I really liked the attentive detail and the level of service. Most companies just take your money and disappear. I chose this company because their products are high quality and their service is genuinely top tier. I'm really happy with my decision.
Really happy with the overall product  and the install process went well and everyone has been helpful along the way.

Put it down to one word - smooth. Everything was explained really well from start to finish in a clear and informative way. We've seen the obvious benefits and are really glad we did it and look forward to extend on that.
The follow up service is phenomenal,  I've had a few check ups and they even replaced my inverter when they found a fault in it
The customer service before, during and after installation has been superb. Great support throughout the whole process. Just recently installed a battery and very happy with it.

We can’t complain about how Resinc has been, everyone has been helpful and professional, and the installers were great. We’re looking forward to seeing what our bills will be because, based on the monitoring app, it looks like they’re going to be a lot less.
Overall good experience, good quality products, no hassle no stress. Good after sales care.

Once I did the research, I noticed you guys are completely different from the usual providers, offering additional services on top, which was outstanding. You did extensive research and ensured our system was future proofed. Overall, the experience is a cut above what you would normally get
The after care support and professionalism is great. Bills have come down since going solar

Solar was something that had been on my radar for a while, but I always knew I wanted to install it with a battery so I could maximise my usage throughout the night when the sun isn’t up. We’re happy we installed with these guys, and it looks like our next bill is going to be a lot lower!
From the first phone call to now, it has been seamless and effortless. No question has ever been too silly throughout the whole process.
Quick and easy experience, and we’ve definitely noticed a reduction in our bills. They’re always available if we have any questions!

review_description: This is the third system I've had installed, with both the previous ones being done by large/mid scale installers, and both were trouble free with a satisfactory process and outcome. This time around I decided to try one of the three referred by Solar quotes and I chose this small scale owner-operator expecting a more personalised and still trouble free process and more active customer service. I was keen to support a small developing business.The quote process was straightforward and David was happy to provide a number of versions as we worked through the options to deal with my own and council's requirements (heritage overlay). The installation was also relatively straightforward, after we had one agreed reschedule just before Christmas. It was completed after the holiday period over 2 days. Once completed I was advised about the need to connect the system to the internet on an ongoing basis, which was news to me and had not been raised before. We are low internet users and rely on a 4G Mobile Internet Device which meets all our needs. However the Goodwe inverter would not connect. To cut a long story short various attempts to connect the system using different equipment did not succeed. Over a number of months, including supposedly waiting for Goodwe to supply a new WI-FI Dongle, the customer service deteriorated to the point that David stopped responding to calls and messages. Eventually I resorted to calling Evan and he was appropriately responsive and made significant efforts to connect the system without success. Eventually I was left to contact Goodwe directly, which I did a number of times, with Evan also not returning my call. After a number of calls and following Goodwe's advice eventually the system connected, but it was still not exporting any power (I know the current feed-in tariff is insignificant, but that's not the point). Eventually, just a few weeks ago (in August) I assume Goodwe discovered the export problem related to the post installation paperwork not been completed. Suddenly I received advice from my distributer and retailer advising receipt of relevant paperwork from the installer, and soon enough as if by magic the system was registered and exporting - all the while not a word from the installer. Throughout the post installation process I was made to feel like a difficult hard to satisfy customer, when in fact it seems that the problem all along was incomplete documentation by the installer. And still not a call to explain the issue, it's resolution, let alone any admission of responsibility or expression of regret. On that basis I can't recommend this installer. Next time I will likely stick to an established reputable higher volume provider with an established customer service charter and a issue resolution process that works and is not person dependent.

He took the time to truly understand our requirements, which made us feel confident in our choices.The installation was done on time, exactly as promised. The team was fantastic—professional, efficient, and very tidy. The entire process was quick and clean, with zero disruption to our day. It was also reassuring to know that the installers are a core part of the Beyond Solar team and not subcontractors.Beyond Solar is a top-notch company that provides not only a competitive quote but also a truly professional and high-quality service. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking to install solar.

A++++ fixed problems left over from a previous installer with my initial 30kw battery. They brought a 50kw and setup for full home backup which the clowns before couldn’t achieve. Fantastic service and workman ship was just 10000%
I’ve commented as to service above. They know their job inside out, giving the wealth of their expertise in location of plant etc.
Great communication and service from the sales enquiry to the installation and commissioning. Friendly, polite, tidy, punctual and efficient.

Great experience working with Beyond Solar. From the very first consultation with Saad to the final flip of the switch, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient. Saad helped me through every step of the process, answered all my silly questions with patience, and delivered exactly what they promised.Installation was quick and clean, with zero disruption to my daily life. The crew showed up on time, worked diligently, and left my property spotless.Since the system went live, I’ve seen a dramatic drop in my energy bills. This is the second time I went with Beyond Solar for my new home, so if you’re considering going solar, I highly recommend Beyond Solar.

The team were great. We hit a hiccup mid-install when the NSW govt pulled the rebates, but this was beyond anybody's control and they kept me informed throughout. They were the most affordable provider I consulted and I believe they use their own installers, not sub-contractors, so they were able to come out quite quickly.

The installation went very well I had a 6.6 kilowatt system fitted to my roof. I did have to have some conduits running on the outside of my building because of limited access into the roof but that's okay something I will have to put up with I suppose. My only problem is that after ordering the panels and the time lapse between that and installation the government has changed the process somewhat and I now require a Wi-Fi connection to the inverter. Unfortunately I don't have Wi-Fi connected. Hmm a problem. Still to be sorted.

We wanted to go with a locally owned Company from our area and from the initial contact with Ben to the final install and instructions on the app nothing was too much trouble for all the staff. The install team went about their job in a professional, courteous manner, which showed we had made the right decision. From quote to install around 10 days and arrived on time as expected. Would not hesitate to recommend Solana Energy Specialists to anyone who wants to deal with a very competent, experienced Company with a good quality product.

The entire process with Solana was remarkably straightforward and reassuring. Immediately after submitting my initial inquiry, a representative (Ben) made contact to book a thorough in-home consultation. We spent quality time discussing my past energy usage and clearly outlining my goals for solar power. It was comforting to know that Solana was focused on quoting a configuration that would genuinely suit my specific needs, not just a standard package.The coordination was flawless; communication between the office team and the tradespeople was great. On the day of the installation, everything went well and proceeded smoothly. Furthermore, I have been happy with the administrative support post-installation and the prompt assistance I received when following up with a couple of questions. Solana delivered exactly as promised.

Right from the quotation stage we were impressed with the service. They were the only Company that came on site prior to submitting a quote.Although the price was higher than others the service offered, the warranty period and dealing with their own people not contractors sealed the deal for us.The installation was done in two lots, owing to bad weather. The crew were great, on time, polite, completed the job on time and cleaned up.The grid connection was done and we were shown how to download the app.Would recommend this Company.
I’d highly recommend Airlec. Their customer service, communication and installation process was exceptional.

We received a response quickly after contacting Solar Quotes and the rep came out to check the site a few days later. The quote came the next day and we accepted the quote and paid the deposit. Installation came a couple of weeks later. The boys were polite and were no bother during the work. The work wasn’t completed in one day so they had to come back the following week to finish the job. We already had PV Panels so were already connected to the grid. We weren’t shown how to use the app but still were very pleased with the finished job.
All installed on time ran through the process explained clearly organised connection all good

David from Watters responded immediately to our initial enquiry, answered all questions and inspected the site before we signed anything. We never felt pressured. Riley and Jack soon after did a follow-up site visit before installation, and returned with Troy and Harley a fortnight later to put in the new batteries, inverter and gateway to go with our existing panels. Troy talked me thru the basics of the system on the day, and the fellas did a very neat, entirely professional job of it. Very pleased with the whole experience, all done within 25 days of asking for a quote. If only it could always be so straightforward to get work done!
Fantastic service to perfection.Polite, tidy, punctual no issues at all

Quote was easy to understand and clearly laid out what I was getting. All applications and sign ups to various grants/synergy/Western Power were managed efficiently and it was clear when i needed to do anything. Install job was great - the guys got right to work, explained where everything would go and helped me get the app sorted on my phone. Everything is working well and i have recommended to friends - the whole process was easy and efficient.

I initially thought blackout protection was included in my quote, but it turned out to be listed as an optional extra. This was a good reminder for me to read quotes more carefully and not assume details based on conversations with a sales representative. There was also a mix-up because the battery couldn’t be installed under the old inverter, and relocating the inverter added an extra $600 cost. Since this wasn’t in the original quote, Sunterra agreed to split the relocation cost with me. I’m happy with the outcome because the battery is now in a better location, and I understand the work involved in moving the inverter.The installation team was very knowledgeable. Once we clarified what I had signed up for, they were excellent—friendly, professional, and their workmanship was of high quality. There was a slight delay in installation due to moving the inverter, but they worked around our availability.During the process of adjusting the power meter box to install the battery, the bedroom fan and bathroom light stopped working. The team quickly fixed the issue, which was caused by my very old meter box and poor wiring.Finally, the team took the time to show me how the new battery works and walked me through the mobile app.

Previous experience with Sunterra provided a high level of confidence in choosing the company for installation of the battery. Initial quoting was provided in a timely manner and was backed up with useful information on the system and its components. Following announcement of the federal scheme a long period of inactivity was experienced. After re-establishing contact, it was advised that some technical aspects had been revised and changes mandated under the rebate scheme conditions. These revisions resulted in a technically superior system with little impact on the initial quote.Approval from the regulators was organised mainly by the company with one interaction required of the buyer. Then came another long waiting period for installation. After an installation date was set, the date was changed on three occasions.Enter the long-awaited arrival of the installation team and all was forgiven. The team was professional and technically experience and competent. Importantly, the team leader engaged openly with the owner and was generous with information and advice and had no problem coping with an interested onlooker following every move. In keeping with the manner in which the installation was conducted, the site was left impeccably tidy with all rubbish removed. It was worth the wait!

Firstly, Sunterra installed my solar panels several years ago, & I found that an overall positive experience - product has been good, service was reasonable & the price was very competitive.So fast forward to second half of 2025, & I wanted to give Sunterra the first option at setting me up with a solar battery post-Govt subsidies. The quoting process was very serviceable & friendly, received good advice & options, & - after just checking around different quotes to get the lay of the land - I was happy to proceed.That's when the process became worse. So after the agreement & go ahead, I heard nothing for about a month. I followed up, & was told I would have someone contact me to arrange an install date. Another 3 weeks passed...a slightly perturbed email went in to the guy who quoted me, who obviously cracked the whip & I got myself an install date.No pre-installation site inspection. That was done by an email with a couple of photos. I recognise this mightn't be an issue for many, but I had a small unique outdoor challenge in regards to locating the battery, & although I got what was a tacit "okay" from their office via email, on the day of install the installers arrived with a "we can't put it there" (it was an issue of concrete pads & sufficient wall space). The installers essentially watched me scramble to come up with a solution. That was a good little indicator of the customer service to come.Install occurs - that's fine. System looks okay to my uneducated eye. Was happy to have got it set up where I wanted it set up. Then one of the installers tried to get me set up with the Shine ap so I could see what was happening with the battery. A few Wifi issues, a few limitations of the ap - the installer is getting frustrated, assures me that once connection with our router is established the ap process itself is a piece of cake. I'm not so confident but I'm reasonably tech-savy - how hard can it be right? Well....The Ap installation & set up is a bloody nightmare. Requests for customer service go unanswered or fobbed off - I get told someone is coming out on a Tuesday afternoon to run me through everything, so I get home from work early afternoon, then get a message saying they're not able to attend. The following Friday I am at work & get a message saying we're coming around now...I tell them Im not actually there....but they go around anyway & end up talking to my 15 year old son which is not helpful. But hey, at least they can say they went around & tried, right?Oh, & then I get the bill and some pressure to pay - while they've charged me for concrete sheeting that they never installed. Managed to get that forted at least - by simply not paying. Then, frankly, my stress levels with this company just became too much & I want them out of my life.So all in all, I have an ap which gives me about 40% of the information I would expect to be able to access about my battery. The solar battery appears to be working okay. I fear having a need to access customer service or - heaven forbid - anything relating to warranty.Overall, Sunterra were the cheapest option when it came to getting a solar battery installed. I think the battery itself is okay - appears to be working quite well. But the Ap you use with it isn't fantastic, at all. And the customer service I experienced with Sunterra is simply the worst I have ever experienced.I do wish I had spent a couple of thousand more to have a company I would feel positive and confident in recontacting for help or advice. And a better Ap.

Landon and his team fully delivered on expectations.Despite complicating changes and delays from the state government, they adapted, effectively communicated progress and finally delivered.Installation though less than staight-forward was professionally completed.Overall - Outstanding.

Having installed offgrid solar myself in the past, Ii tend to give solar companies a hard time as I know what i want and just want options, specs and prices. Dean from Sunterra is awesome, providing all the info I requested and prices in his first response to me. He also stated any unknowns but explained what he thought and got back to me once he had the info available.The system price was great, comms have been awesome and the installers were brilliant :)
All good. We’re very happy with Sunterra, very helpful, the installer very thorough and helpful.

The salespeople at Sunterra were very polite and knowledgeable and explained clearly the system we were getting. The installers arrived on time and introduced themselves and ‘got on’ with the job expertly. They were very friendly and answered any questions we had - I would recommend them to anyone who was looking at a solar install. They assisted in setting up my phone and explained how it worked and what to look for, the connection was taken care of by them and all was working before they left. Our property was left in a clean and tidy state and I would recommend Sunterra.

The application through installation process was smooth and simple. Landon handled all my queries and the rebate applications well. The installers arrived early and finished ahead of schedule. The system is connected, working well and the app is a very handy and informative dashboard. I'm almost looking forward to my next bill to see the benefits!

I had an excellent experience from start to finish! Hakem handled the sales and quoting process and was absolutely fantastic — professional, patient, and transparent. He took the time to explain all my options clearly and made sure I got the best setup for my needs without any pressure.The installation team, led by Jun with his two team members, did an amazing job as well. They arrived right on time, were polite, tidy, and very efficient. The work was done to a high standard, and they left everything clean and perfectly organised once they finished.Customer service was top-notch too — they handled the grid connection and made sure everything was set up properly. Jun even walked me through how to use the charger and made sure I was comfortable with everything before they left.Overall, I couldn’t be happier with the whole experience. Big thanks to Hakem and Jun’s team — highly professional, friendly, and reliable from start to finish. I’d definitely recommend them to anyone!
Great customer service as well as the installation .Professionally done. Overall from the quoting to the final installation all done in a timely manner.

Thankyou Sunterra and especially you Parker for seamlessly organising our solar job.The guys did an awsome job with the install todayThe crew were polite and worked hard and harmonious together all day without a breakA better than expected result in record time and at a very competitive price.Yet another quality install for us by Sunterra and its quality contractors.We have and will continue to recommend Suntera as the first phone call if anyone is wanting to go solar.Good job Parker.Your organisation was very good and your instructions and your information was clear and spot on.It would be appreciated if this PAT on the back was also conveyed to the installation team that installed our solar today.Thanks againBrenton

Had my solar system installed today. The sales process was quick and easy with all questions answered and explained.  The team came on time and did a fantastic job with the installation. The team leader walked us through the system with patience before they left. We would definitely recommend having your battery system with this company. Well done Sunterra!!

Right from the beginning of the sales enquiry, we found the sales specialist, to be polite and patiently responded to the queries we had on the solar system with the batteries. He's gone through with the rebates we are entitled for and explained the complete process in detail. The order was installed in 2 phases and both the times, the service team had installed the solar panels and later on the batteries much before the time that was estimated. The workmanship was apt and the installation team were immaculate in getting their work done. The communication was excellent prior installation with respect to grid connection. They explained in detail the functioning of battery charging and the app which they got us installed was perfect with the relevant information. The entire team from salesman to service team were 5-star. Thanks to Sunterra for their awesome service.

Absolutley no complaints, fitted my system last year and added extra batteries yesterday, always clean tidy tradies, (sorry about the over friendly dog.) Customer service from sales thru to after care is on point. Would highly recommend

The salesperson was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions. I wouldn’t say he was pushy.The installers and electrician were very polite and professional when they turned up at your property and set up the wifi accordingly.Definitely recommend

Satisfaction from wo to go! When I asked for a quote, Jordan came round promptly and explained everything very clearly. We locked in, but needed to wait a week, to get all parts for the meter upgrade. When the guys came to install they were excellent, keeping us informed on what they were doing, and generally very friendly and professional-thanks Mark and Owen. They helped us set up the app. We will watch it for a few days, then try and get our heads around how it is all going, but so far, all good, and no glitches. Variety solar were a great company to work with, especially ensuring we got all 3 rebates, and no hidden extras.

So Variety Solar were excellent from the get go.Firstly and most importantly Jordan's product knowledge was 2nd to none.I love to reseach to death anything I buy, and so Jordan took multiple calls on numerous topics.  It was only after he had answered my 1000th questionsthat we bought the system.Whether it was discussing dc bi-directional charging and whether the module needed to be in the stack, my current usage compared to the battery size, the capability of the gateway, or the average distance in an install between a gas main and the battery, Jordan knew it all.  For the very few times I needed some future product information Jordan hooked me up with Sigenergy's national sales manager to discuss with the source.Then came the install and it was equally as good. Joseph came out on the weekend in his own time because I would not be there on the day of installation and took me through where each component would be installed.  He listened to everything I asked and hey presto when i came back from a work conference it was all done to spec.  Further Joseph and the team were lovely with my children and wife, fixed the internet which had dropped out and helped with another electrical problem we had.You could not do any better than these guys, and if you are like me and have a thirst for knowledge BEFORE you buy then Jordan is your guy.Thanks Variety Solar Team and a big thank-you to solar quotes for the referal.

We had a very positive experience going with Variety Solar.Jordan was extremely helpful  in understanding and finding the right system for us.Joseph and the Installation Team did a great job on the day, very thorough and friendly, including explaining the running of the system to us.It is early days but so far we are impressed with our Anker Solix system.

I had a 30kw battery system installed recently and a 6.4kw solar panel system installed almost 3 years ago.The panels and inverter have worked flawlessly since install, and the battery system has met expectations for the last 10 days or so (less than 1kw a day on average from the grid during a period of mostly cloud and rain).The sales and communication experience with Sam was very positive. The products were selected to meet my requirements with consideration for proven market quality, reliability and performance, and the quote was clear and accurate. Time commitments were met and small delays due to market demand were made clear at the beginning. I received several calls with updates and follow up to make sure everything was working.The electrical contractors for both jobs were exceptional. Friendly, helpful, on time, all the attributes you probably want to be confident with the install. A fault with one of the batteries (arrived not working) was sorted quickly and rectified within a few days.I honestly can't fault anything about the journey from initial contact to switching on the system.I recommend Variety Solar for both panel and battery systems without hesitation.
Quality install. In and out in a day. Cleaned up before they left. Very happy with final results

A bit of a long Journey from July 25 when signed proposal to getting the battery installed in October 25 but mostly due to shortage of stock due to Government rebates. Variety Solar did provide an alterative battery to prevent further delays which was appreciated and install was done without issue. Providing more regular updates to the customer and responding to more promptly is something would suggest improving on.
Customer service was fantastic.  Quote very professional. Installation was done professionally.

I'm very happy and satisfied with the fantastic service and workmanship from Variety Solar. From start to finish, the team made the entire process of installing our solar panel and battery system smooth, professional, and stress-free.Jordan was very knowledgeable and patient, answering all my questions and helping me choose the right system for our needs. The installation crew arrived on time, worked efficiently, and kept everything neat and tidy. I'm especially impressed with their attention to detail and the care they took to ensure everything was set up perfectly.Since the installation, our system has been running flawlessly and we’re already noticing the difference in our energy usage cost.A big thank-you to Solar Quotes for the recommendation and to the entire Variety Solar team for their outstanding service, high-quality products, and seamless installation. I highly recommend them to anyone considering solar — you’ll be in excellent hands!
Thanks to the team and Indris (electrician) for pulling of installing such a big system on time as desired. Can't be happier than that. Thanks to Vividh and Dylan for taking all my hassle as well.

Variety Solar did a great job with the installation of battery (having previously installed solar panels with them)The process was smooth from the start. I received a great price for the battery from them as well as a notice in advance that the battery will take few weeks to arrive since the demands are high at the moment which saves me time to ring them back again.Once battery arrived, it took less than a week for the installer to install it. Have to spend some additional dollers to install bollards and smoke detector for the compliance reason (battery in the garage) but was happy with the price I paid (well below the market price). Electrician assist me with the app functioning to easily charge the battery from grid if needed (off peak or night rates - time based control)Luckily, inspector came to inspect it next day (he was around the area) and did point out couple of small issues but happy with the installation (turn on the battery the same day). The electrician came the next business day and fix the issues.Battery runs smooth since then and let me save $$$ on the electricity.

Started to look for a quote in Jun and was recomended 2 installers from solarquotes.Got 1 quote initiallty but after speaking to Jordan, decided to go with Variety Solar as he explained a lot of details to me and was really patience in creating the various scenarios and combination possible for my home.Had to wait for the stock like most others and there was some confusion with the delivery but it was sorted before the installation date.Entire installation done in a single day, 13kw of new panels, 48kw of Sigenergy battery and the backup gateway and it was well done.Very lucky for me, inspector called the next day and did it on that day itself and system was up and running the same evening.I had a small set of panels before so the required meter was already in place and i got AUSNET's email the next day after the inspection.All good now except for a small issue and some question on the Sigenergy apps but the Jordan is helping to sort those out.Highly recommended.

The process was impressively quick from start to finish. Installation was smooth and professionally handled, with everything up and running in no time. Customer service was responsive, friendly and helpful throughout. Highly recommend for anyone considering solar battery solutions!

The quotations were prompt and follow-up with both parties was efficient. A slightly better knowledge of the preferred battery won the quote for Variety.  I think they run on a just in time model so were focused and keen to get payment ASAP.The installation despite being in rural Victoria was done by the contracted party (not subcontracted) who persevered until the job was completed - working long hours. The site was kept tidy. All the workers were very polite and had time to explain what they were doing (especially the senior installer).The battery has just been inspected so it's a little early to see how some of  our questions about implementation will b e addressed but I am optimistic.

I actually reached out to variety solar a year or so ago to expands my battery. It didn't make sense then to install. So I contacted Jordan again this tielme with rebates and he not only remembered my issue but went above and beyond to get the best outcome for my situation. He was patient and thorough throughout the discovery process.  In the end got some battery modules installed and they were installed very smoothly detailing the steps along the way. Satisfied with the install, price and service.
We were very happy with the communication, pricing & the punctuality.
Paid a deposit to have a system installed by this businessInstall is in November 2025

Great service from Arctic Energy Toowoomba, very happy with the installation and system. I purchased a 6.6Kw Solar system with an 8Kw Sigenergy Battery, only had the system a month so far but seems to be working very well.I have a 1960s built single level home with an original iron roof that had an older small solar system installed that was no longer working, this system was uninstalled and taken away by Artic at no extra cost.I would have no hesitation in recommending Arctic Energy Toowoomba

Jeff was amazing to deal with! He came out to inspect the roof and discuss the options available to us to achieve the best results with a solar system. He answered questions quickly and made changes to systems and quotes until we had settled on what we were going to do. He was even happy to organise removal of our old system so our roof could be restored and then organise install of the new system once it was all finished. He kept us up to date with wait times on the battery. Even when the new system was up and running, he was happy to answer questions and provide additional information to help us understand the app to control the battery and manage our power. Couldn't ask for more!
company_name: Energised Electrical and Air Conditioning Pty Ltd

review_description: I engaged KIK Electrics to install solar panels on my new build a couple of years ago.  From the outset they were exceptional, from the quoting process, through to applying for the solar rebate and loan.  When it came to installation Dante and his team were knowlegable, punctual and able to put me at ease straight away.  The fact that they had to come back twice, once to do the roughins and the other to install the panels was done without fuss was fantastic, considering the distance they had to travel.  Justin was more happy to answer my stupid questions and organise the comissioning of the system in a timely and efficient manner.  I highly recommend KIK for anything solar related. Thank you guys.

Had KIK Electrics recommended through this site. Went with them despite being more expensive than I'd hoped - had found cheaper services previously didn't really have super outcomes so hoped if I spent a bit more this time I might be better off. Absolutely no problems with the system as far as I can tell - seems to be working really well and we are not drawing from the grid at all. Problem is, we can't feed into the grid because KIK have not sent on the proper documentation to the energy provider. This means that we can't provide any excess energy produced into the grid and our system shuts down if production exceeds use and the battery is already full, which is a massive waste. Company won't reply to me now - massive red flag!!! I have also found out that our VicSolar loan has not been able to commence because they haven't sent the paperwork to them either, so something seems to be going wrong at that end of the business. Will be interesting to see if I can ever get this system feeding into the grid and how it will operate when at full capacity. At the moment, although a 11+kW system, I have never had it produce more than around 4kW at any time, as I can't export the excess. So, fair to say my experience with them has not been great. Having said this, their installation was fast and tidy, so nothing wrong with that side of things.

Two installers recommended by SolarQuotes were very punctual and close on prices quoted (the third was very slow). However, I selected KIK electrics who were not on the list provided by SolarQuotes but were on their list of reviewed installers. KIK electrics consistently had high scores (4-5) from reviewers and, importantly, zero poor reviews. A poor review can be 'flushed away' by an adequate installer response, but otherwise they just sit there and contaminate a lot of otherwise good work.One of two directors of KIK electrics, Justin, answered my phone call and was immediately on top of my requirements. Their quote was similar to the earlier two, and Justin made helpful suggestions about a modular BYD battery, and waiting to collect data from the Fronius inverter to see if we really needed to spend more on another module for the battery.The installation team of four arrived at 8am on the appointed day and worked till 6pm in 30+ degrees to get the job completed. Justin arrived the next morning to set up the monitoring system and install a (free) range extender. Justin also organised all of the grid connection details and has been happy to answer a few follow-up queries.

We had our solar system installed by KIK a couple of years ago and we were exceedingly happy, so we naturally turned to them for the battery / heat pump.  This is where we discovered their customer service is now so bad it's actively impacted our impression of the company to the point where we don't want them anywhere near our systems.We sent an enquiry trying to determine feasibility of placement since this would affect several other renovation projects.  We promptly received back an AI generated response and a full blown quote for equipment we did not request.We explained our situation again, and finally got a site visit / feasibility, which was then followed by another quote - then high pressure sales tactics. Endless calls during the work day which went unanswered due to the fact I was working, with no voicemails, more AI generated emails referring to things we did not agree to or discuss and finally a "do by X date"When we tried to find out more information about the quoted equipment...nothing.  We have still not heard a response. It's been a couple of months now and we have zero interest in doing any further business with this company.

As a tradie myself running a small business,  it's good to see other businesses going around who know what they are doing. Lumos Electrical was straight forward with good ideas, experience, confident in doing the job and  knowledgeable. Exactly what you need when you are unsure of things.  From the moment they finished, everything was up and running perfect. They were neat and tidy and answered all my questions. Definitely recommend them.

Damien came out to quote on a Solar Battery install. Gave me some great, no BS, advice and a very reasonable quote. Josh came out to do the install and has done a very neat and professional installation. Damien came out for the commissioning and to give me a run down of the app and how to manage the battery. Everything from start to finish has been well-managed with great communication and execution.  Would (and have) definitely recommend.

We would highly recommend Lumos. If we could give them more than 5 stars we would.From quote to installation and after sales service, we found Damien and his team to be outstanding, providing high quality service at a very reasonable price.Damien’s knowledge of the solar industry is exceptional and his advice on the best system for us took the stress out of decision-making and made the whole process very easy.We put in a 13.2kW solar system with a 10kWHybrid Inverter and 25kW battery. We also replaced our old (inefficient) solar hot water system with a heat pump (on Damien’s advice) and we are so happy with it.Josh, Issac and Logan did an excellent job installing the whole system. The quality of their work is outstanding and, as an added bonus, they are genuinely lovely young tradies – personable and courteous.We were particularly impressed with Josh. Not only did he spot a few issues with existing electrics (and fixed them), his excellent communication and customer service skills ensured we were kept well  informed and updated every step of the way.We were also very impressed with how clean and tidy the boys were and how respectful they were when entering our house – work boots off every time. Having had many trades through our house over the past 3 months, I can say that this level of care is uncommon, and very much appreciated.If you’re considering a solar system, or any electrical work, we strongly recommend going with Damien and his team at Lumos.

The crew turned up on time and did an awesome job. They also left the place neat and tidy.I've got the opportunity to see a finished installation as reference.Customer service after installation and support is brilliant
The installer was very communicative promptly answering all my question, quality of the install was impeccable
Amin was very helpful and install team was great, on time and tidy

After a disappointing experience with the installer who originally fitted my solar panels three years ago, which I initially considered using the same company for my solar battery installation to keep everything under one provider, I decided to explore other options.Following an initial call with a Level electrical representative and sending my electrical for the last few months, I was scheduled an appointment with electrical designer Amir. He provided me with a much better package, helped rationalise my purchase based on my actual needs, and offered clear, sensible advice.On installation day, everything went according to plan. When I had a question, Amir personally called to explain things in detail. The communication throughout the installation was excellent, and the work was carried out neatly and professionally.The follow-up after installation has also been outstanding, with remote monitoring support and practical advice on balancing my energy usage.Initially, I was hesitant to sign up with Level Electrical given the limited reviews available on SolarQuotes, but I can honestly say I am very pleasantly surprised and impressed so far.In contrast, my original installer, EISS, showed little to no planning for the system at all and I felt was favoured for asking questions. They took an instalment payment in mid-May for a July installation (with the rebate), held onto the money for few weeks, then eventually returned it after saying they weren’t sure about the system. Later, when I approached them again, they had no issue to install the very same system they had rejected—this time with an extra $2,000 added, saying: “Sorry mate, prices have increased.”

Had to chip the sales person regarding "whole has backup" - after deposit paid he said that it was not possible but all documentation received said that it could be done - some compromises made.Grid connection (3 phase) was done by company with no real issues.Installation was professional.After one week operation, had a query regarding minimum battery drawdown and this was done promptly and remotely.The information provided on the app is fantastic and has allowed me to adjust the timing of the hot water system and pool pump to suit maximum solar production.

I contacted Clayton Solar about installation of a solar battery. A quote was provided with explanation of various sizes and which one would be the best for us. review_description: Shane, Stavros and the team are amazing.Quality advice that’s easy to understand and willing to help any time.I’ve now had both a solar systems and a battery with zero issues, great performance and great care for quality and aesthetics.The real surprise is that all this comes and price that literally no one came close to matching.

review_description: Great installation job by the team and they picked a great place for the battery, helped with the app installation and use, I got a bigger battery than expected so it was excellent value for money!

review_description: I chose Clayton Solar & Electrical to install my system a few years ago; because of their friendly customer service, helpful professional advice in choosing the right product/s, and competitive quote. They went on to impress me further with a seamless installation by a friendly team, and by helping me to navigate the steps required for my energy provider, connecting to Wi-Fi, using the app, and much more. Since then, Shane has provided ongoing technical support & advice anytime I’ve needed it over the years, including prompt advice on how to safely isolate the system after recently suffering major storm damage.So when this storm damage meant I needed a replacement system, I was understandably concerned that the building company managing my repairs was intending to assign their own solar installer to do so. I didn’t want to lose my preferred solar support team! After explaining this to the building supervisor, he agreed to onboard Clayton Solar to do my new installation, for which I am incredibly grateful.My second installation by Clayton Solar went as smoothly as the first, including the post install support again. I love that most of the team was the same as the first time, a sign that it must be a great place to work too, and Tim even went above and beyond by cleaning storm debris out of my garage for me before heading off (it was still full of leaves and dirt from the storm).Reading positive reviews lead me to Clayton Solar in the first place, so I hope this one helps you to choose too. I can’t recommend them highly enough, and of note I have since received thanks from my repairs building company for the referral… it seems they are so impressed by the team that they are already seeking their services again.Thank you Shane, Tim & all of the team at Clayton Solar.

review_description: We recently had a 13.4kWh Sigenergy battery and solar panels installed by Clayton Solar and couldn't be happier with the experience.The team was professional, punctual, and transparent throughout the process- from quoting G to post installation support.They took the time to explain setup, system performance, and monitoring app in plain language.The installation was tidy, and the system is working exactly as promised.Highly recommend Clayton Solar for anyone  looking for a reliable, knowledgeable solar provider.
company_name: Clayton Solar and Electrical Pty Ltd

review_description: My experience with Solar Galaxy has been nothing short of a nightmare. Before making the deposit, their team was incredibly responsive and friendly—answering all my questions promptly and giving me a sense of confidence in their service.However, everything changed the moment the deposit was made. I sent numerous follow-up emails over the course of a month, and not a single one was answered. No updates, no timeframes, no acknowledgment—just complete silence. It felt like they vanished the moment they received my payment.This kind of behavior is not just unprofessional, it's deeply concerning. I trusted them, and they completely ignored my queries without explanation. I would strongly caution others to think twice before engaging with Solary Galaxy.

Sales and quote are thorough, detailed and clearly explain costs and expected benefits.Installation process was fully explained and caused the least disruption possible.  Everything was left as it was found and no sign of the extensive work that had occurred remained after the installation.Customer service was as I have experienced previously, very easy and I was given explanations in a way that I could understand making my decision process much less complicated.The technicians carrying out the installation explained what they were doing in a way that made sense to me and showed me what they were going to do before they started work.I have explained my future plans to the Kelso sales team and they have given me options within my capability to understand.Installing solar power is a complicated process, Kelso made it as easy as possible and much less difficult than trying to understand the offers made by any electricity supply company.

Kelso Armidale were efficient in the sales and quoting of my new solar panels.  The installation team arrived at the time arranged, were efficient, friendly and considerate as I have a small dog who needed to be accommodated with opening and closing gates etc.The team worked well together and, following completion of the job, cleaned up my yard and roof.The team leader explained the system and app to me, answering all my questions.Would highly recommend Kelso Armidale.

I was very happy with the prompt responses and quality workmanship I received regarding my solar installation.Everything was done on time and in a professional manner. The installers were friendly, happy to answer questions, polite, and even tidied up after themselves.Perhaps a little more expensive than some other installers but I'm confident that the product quality and careful installation reflects the longevity of the product.

Sales and quoting process was flexible, prompt, helpful and informative.Install was punctual, friendly, neat and informative.After sales consultations and follow-up have been great.Calls are answered, and they have got back to us quickly if required.We felt looked after.

The Kelso team installed our solar panels a couple of years ago. They were helpful, knowledgeable and very reliable.We have now expanded our setup to include batteries. Again, Kelso’s have proven to be well-priced, timely and have done another top notch installation job.

The quotation process was pretty easy, with a few adjustments along the way. I limited quotations to Tesla systems, something Volteam had extensive experience with. I appreciated the knowledge of Nick Hamidi who advised of a potential issue with my preferred Tesla 27kw installation in the garage on a wall. He advised that 0.9m clearance was needed to avoid issues with the manufacturer warrantee. Changed to being outside garage and pads were needed to support the heavy batteries, but no bollards. I accepted the revised quote - not the cheapest for exactly the same system.A pre installation inspection took place, with a statement the gateway would be outside (not what I wanted as this would leave lots of holes in the wall from the prior inverter). The message had not got through about the batteries now being outside. I again advised that the garage wall was brick veneer not solid brick.Installation day - installer ok with installing Gateway in garage where old inverter had been - excellent, but the message about the wall being brick veneer had not. Holes were being drilled but no concrete supports were expected needed as the information on the wall being veneer had not gotten through. Fortunately I was observing and notified the installer. Quick discussion with a second person from Volteam that the install would have to be postponed. When I suggested all that was required was getting concrete pads this is what occurred and the instal continued.I would have liked a bit more info on the Tesla app, but overall very happy. A month later now and the batteries are working well.

From quote to install we have been very impressed by Volteam electric.Only company who came on site to provide a quote out of the 3 quotes we got.We were very impressed with the neat and tidy installation.

Voltbeam was the only company of the 3 suppliers identified who actually visited my property and met with me face toface before giving a quote.  I know that satellite images, photos of the switch box, and power bills provide the required information to generate a quote, but I appreciated the time and effort to visit my home and discuss the options.  The quote came through very quickly.  It was clearly detailed, itemised, with explanatory information.  My questions were answered quickly and clearly. The customer service and support teams were very professional as were the installation crew.  They explained everything that would be done, were always on time, were very well mannered, and left our place spotless.  They helped me organise all the connections and apps etc.  I thoroughly recommend Voltbeam.

From start to finish, dealing with Volteam was a pleasure!Quoting was fast and the team was always available for my questions. The lead-up to the agreed install day was great. Phone calls and texts kept me up to date with plans and expectations. The team arrived on time and set up a work zone, which I appreciate from a safety viewpoint. Tom and the team on the day were again happy to answer my questions.Work was completed extremely neatly and the team were careful around freshly painted walls. After installation, Tom showed me the app and how to use certain features.Thank you Volteam!
Quote process was simple.Installation went well.So far all working well :)

Adelaide Solarsafe visited site and explained how and where the system elements would be installed. They also explained how time of use energy tariffs worked and how to minimise costs.The installation date was confirmed several weeks before and the installers arrived as promised on the agreed date and completed the installation in one day. Being an older home with an extension there were some installation issues which they quickly addressed. The completed installation was very neat and tidy and the site was left clean and tidy.The installation crew were very polite and ensured I had the mySigen App loaded and I understood the basics before they left.As a retired electrical engineer I would certainly recommend Adelaide Solarsafe to anyone considering installing a solar system.

Initial meeting and subsequent discussions regarding the design and installation of a battery for our existing solar system reassured us that we were dealing with an experienced and honest company. We have particular energy needs and SolarSafe took these requirements into account when designing the solution.On the day of the installation the work was done without fuss, The team was punctual, very polite and were all too happy to answer any of our questions. When works had been completed the site was left very clean. The handover process was thorough and conducted at a pace that I found comfortable.All in all we were very happy with the solution and its installation.

The sales person was thorough and professional, as well as informative and responsive to questions. He brought a drone and used it to view the existing solar array on the roof, enabling him to better advise on feasibility of expansion. He also provided detailed, plain English explanations of different options and approaches to battery addition. These included the implications for future household power use and power provider plans to best match battery plus solar option(s). He inspected our property to see where we thought the battery and related system pieces would go and offered his opinions. Those resulted in a couple of minor changes - both for the better.He provided detailed quotations within a week and they clearly had been designed with our specific situation in mind - not based on a template with cut and pasted changes.We were able to get the installation scheduled for our preferred date, which was 2 months away. The installers arrived promptly on the specified morning,  but not too early. They were polite and efficient. We were able to carry on our normal routine with only a short power interruption in the early afternoon (~90 minutes). They gave us plenty of warning and were happy to fit the power cut around our needs.The installation was scheduled to take 2 days but the team were finished in 1 day. Locating battery and system components followed the plan discussed with the salesperson and resulted in an easier installation, according to the leading hand.Once installed, they took us through the app installation and briefed us on its use. That went as well as could be expected and teh app is pretty well designed. I am finding it more accessible and useable than most such tools. They also briefed us on the components of the system and the procedures involved in switching them on and off, isolating parts of the system, etc. They performed a backup test by switching off the grid supply and the battery continued power supply seamlessly. They also tested the AC charger installed for use with our electric vehicle, to determine the maximum charging power available.Overall, our experience has been excellent, from quoting through to installation. We hope our ongoing experience using the system will be similarly excellent.

From the 2 visits Andy did helping us with lots of questions to Ash and his spot on scheduling...it was faultless.  The team of 4 installers worked flat put and kept the property tidy. I am recommending them to my mother in law
The installation went seemlessly and the interruption free change to battery with a mains fail is fantastic

Very knowledgable and everything was easy and courteous. A pleasure to deal with. 6.6kW in 17 Jinko panels, 10 North, 4 West, and 3 East.  It caps out at 5kW limit from about 10:30am through to 4:00pm on clear days during November, and fully covers an electric kettle by 8:30am

Highly detailed and knowledgeable consultation and sale processes, good communication, professional and attentive and high quality installation. Minor issue - we initially agreed on the location of the Gateway but this wasn't communicated internally - they took full responsibility and moved it no questions asked.

Had some great advice from James the salesman on which solar battery to select.The installation went smoothly with the team dead on time!Terrific customer service with good explanations on how system works in layman’s terms.

Andy came out to the house to view the location of the panels and inverter and then provided excellent advice and a comprehensive quote.Install was a breeze, team turned up on time, installed the system exactly as quoted, cleaned up, removed all packaging and explained how to use the system using the app.Had the system for a couple of months now and we are very pleased with the performance. Been able to charge the EV totally from solar since the system was fitted and that is during the winter months.Very much recommend Adelaide Solarsafe for an excellent system and install.

We recently upgraded our aging rooftop solar system to a new SigEnergy Solar (16kw) and Battery (24kw) system with Adelaide Solar Safe.We had reservations about the price and return on investment.  However, now the system is installed, we are very happy with the amount of energy generated, and available to use during peak energy price periods.  We have significantly reduced our reliance on the grid, and now have the capacity to charge a PHEV.The team at Adelaide Solar Safe were very helpful in discussing the installation package recommended for our needs.  The installation team were very communicative in planning installation dates, explaining system details and use, and how to use of the SigEnergy Phone App.The installation was done very efficiently and neatly and the site was left spotless after completion.We are very happy with the entire process and final product.

Sales/quoting process:  I felt this was good and informative. There was a reasonable amount of flexibility as my response was not made within the time limit of the quote.The installers were punctual and polite.  While the possibility of damage to quite a few roof tiles was advised very few were damaged. Finally, there was no post installation mess.I felt the customer service was good,

I recently commissioned a solar system with SolarSafe and was thoroughly impressed by their service. From start to finish, they were polite, informative, and professional. I highly recommend them for anyone considering investing in solar panels and batteries.

The quoting process was by far the best and easiest out of all the companies I had dealings with.They gave me a fair price for exactly what I was looking for, no dramas at all. During the lead up to installation I was kept in the loop via email as to what was happening in regard to all the dealings western power and synergy. I didn’t have to do anything. On the day of installation the guys were on time polite and did a great job, no problems at all.After sales service was off the chart, fantastic.Great company in my opinion.Thanks again Stuart and the team at Koala Solar

I recently decided to install a solar + battery system thanks to the federal and state rebates, so I shopped around and collected several quotes. Koala Solar immediately stood out from the pack. Their no-nonsense, straight-forward approach (with zero confusing jargon or pushy sales tactics) made the whole process easy to understand. Their quote was also more competitive than the others I received and I really appreciated that they use their own in-house team rather than subcontractors.Sean did an excellent job walking me through the options and tweaking the system to suit my specific needs. Bri and Shyniah kept me in the loop leading up to installation day so I knew exactly what to expect.Stu (the owner) and his team arrived at 7am on the dot and were super friendly, polite and professional. They talked me through the process and kept disruption to an absolute minimum.  My power was off for only about 30 minutes, which is impressive given it was a full solar, inverter, gateway and battery install. The whole job was completed in about 3 hours and the workmanship was clean and tidy. Stu’s enthusiasm and passion for solar is obvious, and he even helped me get the Sigenergy app set up and enabled Modbus so I could integrate everything into Home Assistant - a big plus for someone who likes to nerd out on the data and automations!The system has been running perfectly so far. Despite the overcast weather, five days in and we haven’t needed to import anything from the grid - even overnight. I highly recommend Koala Solar to anyone in Perth looking for a quality installation at a fair price. Great, personalised service from start to finish.

We wanted to capitalize on the battery rebate by adding a battery to our existing solar system. The team at Koala advised us on our best options, providing clear guidance tailored to our setup.Having had a great experience with them during our initial 6.6 kWh solar installation on a single phase with a Fronius Gen24 in 2023, we felt confident going ahead with the battery installation, assured we were in safe hands with their ongoing support.We couldn't be happier with the outcome. The 16.6 kWh battery size is perfect for our needs, and the installation looks incredibly neat. We found the entire process, from the initial quote to the final installation, to be friendly, professional, and completely hassle-free.Highly recommend Koala for their expertise and exceptional service.

My solar system is going to be installed in February. Koala solar recommended me the three phase system which I think is the best for my house.Price is in the  Solar quotes recommended range and they are willing to keep existing 5kw panels and add 6.6 kW extra panels.

Two years ago, Koala Solar expertly designed and installed a Fronius 3-phase 10kW inverter paired with 30 x 440W JA Solar Deep Blue panels. Couldn’t be happier with the results!

The quote came through with all the options I requested and was cheaper than other quotes I received.The installation went really well, the guys turned up on time and got to work right away. The whole process went much quicker than I expected.Once the installation was finished the guys explained how it all worked and talked us through how to download and use the App.

I had a great experience using Koala solar for both my panel, Tesla EV wall charger and battery installation. Excellent value and communication throughout. Very smooth and professional installation. I highly recommend.

We found Koala Solar online and the whole journey from quote to execution was seamless! The koala solar installers who came by were also knowledgeable and they were able to complete the installation in a short time despite the rain.Their prices are also reasonable. I would recommend Koala solar if you looking for a solar provider.

The sales process was easy and never pushy — everything was clearly explained.The installation was faultless, tidy, and thoughtfully carried out, with the team taking the time to explain the system and how to use the app once it was up and running.The Koala Solar team was outstanding throughout, with excellent communication and all paperwork and grid connection handled seamlessly. A genuinely professional and friendly experience from start to finish.

The people were all friendly, efficient and courteous during the whole process from quote to installation. All required paperwork was done promptly by them. Great experience overall.
i was very impressed with the communication from start to finish with a very competitive price.they turned up on time on the day of installation and left no mess when they left.

Once again, Koala Solar have lived up to their reputation as a friendly, helpful and efficient administration and works scheduling team. (they had already installed my Solar panels and inverter 9 years ago)Today, Koala Solar installed a FranklinWH aPower solar battery and A-Gate at my Australind residence.Couldn't be more happy. Answered all of my questions and left me feeling very content with the work and the product they installed.You won't get better service than what these proud people provide.Ian R

Quote was very detailed and Sean explained all the details and the process without being a pushy sales person.I asked for a site inspection before install to ensure there would be no surprises and they were punctual and explained the process on the day.Install day Again they arrived on time, were polite, worked around me when they needed to turn the power off, did a fantastic install, everything is labeled and left the place spotless.

I can’t speak highly enough of Koala Solar!Right from the get go Koala were really helpful and easy to talk to directly, as well as being the least pushy in terms of sales. I could always speak to them the same day regarding any queries.Out of multiple quotes I received, Koala were the most competitive and the only ones to get up on my roof and measured to check that my system would fit and confirm the minimum amount of panels.My 11kw system was a tricky install with several roof sections, but Koala did an awesome job that is neat and delivers great solar production. Importantly, they also use their own install team, headed by the company owners!I’d previously had a bad experience with another Perth installer that couldn’t deliver on what they’d quoted and I learnt how important it is to have a company that measures the roof area and also uses their own experienced install team!A month after install I couldn’t be happier with the system that Koala delivered. I look at this as a 25 year investment, and Koala gave me the best fit for me to future proof my energy needs.Thanks again to the office and install teams!

After months of e-mails, phone calls, requirement changes, rebates coming and going…we finally came to the end, and I could not be happier. Koala stayed in touch throughout the whole process and once all settled down gave me a quote and installation happened a few days later as they fitted me in on a Saturday.Cory and his team arrived a few minutes earlier than scheduled and about 6 hours later they were on their way.I had a million questions, and all were answered during and after the installation. The place was left as clean as before they arrived…I kept my old panels and the BYD batteries as it was going to a friend but everything else was gone and all I have left is a brand-new system that works as expected…Overall, I am as happy as….and would recommend (and have a few times already) Koala any day…could not ask for a more accommodating team.I replaced an old Fronius with BYD batteries and my new system is a Sigenery unit, 14 kW on the roof, 10kw inverter and 16kWh battery…which I might upgrade to 24kWH and a 3-phase EV charger.

This is the second time we have used Koala Solar, and once again the process has been smooth and trouble free. Quoting was a breeze, scheduling the job very easy (thanks Bri and Kristy), and installation was very professionally completed. Highly recommended.
While the quote did come a little later than others, they were the most competitive and answered all my questions.The installation was on time and had no dramas.

Very happy with Koala Solar, I would recommend them to family and friends. Quote, install and customer support have been painless and very responsive. Install was efficient and they left the site clean and tidy no complaints about workman ship.

I requested a quote 24/06/25, received my quote on 27/06/25 and everything was installed and up and running 29/08/25. Koala provided a comprehensive quote and promptly answered any questions I had. They managed all of the interfaces with my energy provider and for both the federal and WA battery rebates without any issues. Installation of the 10KW system (21 panels) , 5KW Inverter, Gateway and 16.12KW Battery system took just 6hrs from start to finish and the team explained the App on my mobile phone in detail - although the App itself is pretty easy to understand

Working with Koala Solar has been a great no fuss and pleasant experience. Right from the first quote from theirs sales Rep Sean and his honesty with regards to the pricing, product and the govt rebates and VVP information (both federal and state). No extra jargon and not pushy at all to sell you anything. Once we discussed what our requirements were and once, I mentioned I was keen to have the sigenstor battery and inverter system installed with a 10kw solar array, the pricing, quote and follow up from there were great. Their prices were best if not better than a few big name company.They managed to get me an install much earlier than originally anticipated (a couple of months earlier). I had a few questions about Bollards as the battery was going to be installed in the garage, and the customer support rep Brianna and her team were excellent in answering all my questions.Today was my install and the team was on time (actually ahead of time) and managed to finish the install within a few hours. The installer Callum and his team were professional, courteous and polite and always cleaned up after completing parts of the job. They walked me through what they were going to do and once completed, they showed me what was done. Once the install was complete, we had a discussion on how to use the system, including using the app and explaining the different modes of the battery and some advice on how to use it for the best outcome of a low bill. Overall the install was very professional and looks great. Now to count the savings.

Great team and company, what a pleasure to deal with!Adam initially quoted an 11kWh BYD battery in March when the WA Battery rebate was announced.  He was very accommodating and never tried to upsell, it was obvious with the rebate that maximising the battery for our home was our goal.  We settled for 2 x 11kWh battery storage with a combiner box in the end.Installed was booked for mid July but due to combiner box out of stock, this was delayed to mid September when the next BYD shipment arrived in Australia.  Bri from the office was great, from communicating of the delay to shuffling the installer schedule for the installation in mid September.Both Alex and Dylan rocked up early to set up the Batteries and the required electrical work, all done and dusted after 6 1/2+ hours, Dylan ensured the battery was functional and charged via solar.  The guys left the place clean and tidy, could not fault them at all.Overall, very happy with Alex and Dylan's work and BYD battery powering the house in the evening as expected.  Big thank you to Bri, Kristy and Adam for the great customer service.  Will definitely recommend Koala Solar to our colleagues, friends and families.

I recently had a 10 kW Sigenergy inverter with 18.04 kW of Aiko panels and a 32 kWh battery installed by Koala Solar, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience.From the very beginning, Sean was my main contact and he has been excellent. I sent him multiple emails with lots of detailed questions, and he always got back to me with accurate answers. If he wasn’t sure, he would follow up with the right people and come back with the correct information. I wouldn’t say every answer was instant — sometimes I had to follow up — but given how busy the rebate period has been, that was completely understandable.
