review_description: Midland Solar were fantastic to deal with. The quoting process was clear and quick, and the installation was punctual, tidy, and very efficient. The team communicated well throughout the whole process and made everything easy. They handled the grid connection and checked in afterwards to make sure everything was working properly. Great service and highly recommended.

Dealing with Midland Solar was great. Leah came out to assess our property, providing options and educating us on the best savings and how our system would work.The installation crew arrived on time and worked efficiently.We have changed electricity providers and recieved our first bill and couldnt believe the savings already, we couldnt be happier. Our system was sized correctly for our needsFrom sales, to administration, to installation, the entire team was fantastic.Thank you Midland Solar!
Excellent from quoting to installation.  Everyone was very helpful from the onset.

Fantastic company to deal with. Leah was terrific, great source of information, she suggested the battery size to add on to our existing solar setup, and she was spot on. Really great communication from her and from the installer subsequently. Very happy with the outcome! And so pleased they are local as well.

Midland Solar were wonderful for my battery installation. High integrity, great communication, punctual and friendly. Can’t speak highly enough - I love my new SigEn battery and am enjoying being in control of my energy costs! So liberating…

Leah & Andy were incredibly helpful every step of the way and were very upfront and honest throughout the the entire process. I am very happy with my ALPHAESS system, there was a minor issue with the way the safety bollard was placed and when I told Midland Solar they very quickly rectified the issue and it passed the ESV inspection with no issues. I recommend Midland Solar highly and it was a pleasure doing business with them.

The quote from Midland was clear and was slightly lower than the others. Once I had decided on Midland to install my solar panels they were very responsive and listened to all my queries and accepted all my particular requests regarding the installation. The installation itself was done very promptly and the team of installer did the job very efficiently. We are very happy with the completed job and the costs was very  reasonable.

We chose to use Midland Solar again after having them install our solar a few years ago, although we did get quotes from other companies, none matched up to the service we previously experienced with Midland Solar.  Once again they didn’t disappoint.I have to heap praise on Leah who was incredibly patient and helpful, answering my many questions happily, and if she didn't know an answer straight away she took the time to research and get back to me quickly.  Andy was also great to deal with, keeping us informed of progress, ensuring we understood the rebate process and responding to our calls quickly.This time we installed a Haier heat pump and a new electric oven to replace a gas one, and the team also capped the gas at the meter as part of the job. The installers were excellent—professional, accommodating of my requests, tidied up afterwards, and it was clear they were skilled tradespeople.  They also took the time to explain the new hot water system to me.We've found the new hot water system really good —the water is hotter than our old system, so we’ve had to use a bit more cold water to balance it, the pressure is strong and consistent.Overall, we’re very happy with the experience and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Midland Solar. They even offered us a Marong special discount, which we really appreciated.
Great customer service. Battery supply is the current issue due to high demand.

We selected Midland Solar as we had dealt with them before and were impressed with the process. Leah helped us assess our usage and we added extra solar panels and a 13.5kwh battery. Andy completed a site inspection and the System was installed in July 25. On sunny days we are not using electricty from the grid during the day and still have enough charge the battery to cover the peak times which is great for winter. On days that we are away from home we are fully charging our battery from solar, and not drawing from the grid at all. We are confident to recommend Midland Solar to others without hesitation.

Midland Solar are amazing to deal with. We have renewed our panels as well as bought a solar battery. They have been fantastic in every aspect of our purchases. They are very knowledgeable and nothing is too much trouble for them. Leah and Andy are wonderful in every aspect of sales and service. I highly recommend them is you are looking at getting solar.
All aspects of the installation of my solar panels were managed professionally and efficiently.  I could not have asked for better service

A fantastic  installation which was more involved due to placing it away from the house. The installer was friendly and answered all our questions. Efficient and tidied up afterwards......very impressed. The sales and quoting was very helpful.

Sales process was efficient and informativeInstallation was timely and undertaken really neatly. They took the time to ensure that there were no ugly conduits that were surface mounted and instead ran the power through my walls, despite this being a more expensive solution that required more complex insulation.Great company to deal with.
Thanks Andy and group for the friendly, professional service. Well done keep up the great work.

The quotation process was pretty easy, with a few adjustments along the way. I limited quotations to Tesla systems, something Volteam had extensive experience with. I appreciated the knowledge of Nick Hamidi who advised of a potential issue with my preferred Tesla 27kw installation in the garage on a wall. He advised that 0.9m clearance was needed to avoid issues with the manufacturer warrantee. Changed to being outside garage and pads were needed to support the heavy batteries, but no bollards. I accepted the revised quote - not the cheapest for exactly the same system.A pre installation inspection took place, with a statement the gateway would be outside (not what I wanted as this would leave lots of holes in the wall from the prior inverter). The message had not got through about the batteries now being outside. I again advised that the garage wall was brick veneer not solid brick.Installation day - installer ok with installing Gateway in garage where old inverter had been - excellent, but the message about the wall being brick veneer had not. Holes were being drilled but no concrete supports were expected needed as the information on the wall being veneer had not gotten through. Fortunately I was observing and notified the installer. Quick discussion with a second person from Volteam that the install would have to be postponed. When I suggested all that was required was getting concrete pads this is what occurred and the instal continued.I would have liked a bit more info on the Tesla app, but overall very happy. A month later now and the batteries are working well.

From quote to install we have been very impressed by Volteam electric.Only company who came on site to provide a quote out of the 3 quotes we got.We were very impressed with the neat and tidy installation.

Voltbeam was the only company of the 3 suppliers identified who actually visited my property and met with me face toface before giving a quote.  I know that satellite images, photos of the switch box, and power bills provide the required information to generate a quote, but I appreciated the time and effort to visit my home and discuss the options.  The quote came through very quickly.  It was clearly detailed, itemised, with explanatory information.  My questions were answered quickly and clearly. The customer service and support teams were very professional as were the installation crew.  They explained everything that would be done, were always on time, were very well mannered, and left our place spotless.  They helped me organise all the connections and apps etc.  I thoroughly recommend Voltbeam.

From start to finish, dealing with Volteam was a pleasure!Quoting was fast and the team was always available for my questions. The lead-up to the agreed install day was great. Phone calls and texts kept me up to date with plans and expectations. The team arrived on time and set up a work zone, which I appreciate from a safety viewpoint. Tom and the team on the day were again happy to answer my questions.Work was completed extremely neatly and the team were careful around freshly painted walls. After installation, Tom showed me the app and how to use certain features.Thank you Volteam!
Quote process was simple.Installation went well.So far all working well :)
Over all very good everything explainedVery good to deal with would recommend

From start to completion Solargain Gippsland were amazing.  Ben gave us lots of time during the initial engagement and development phase to ensure we understood the system, what was being proposed and how it would work.  All our queries were answered and Ben always responded in a timely manner and displayed the utmost professionalism from start to finish.  On site Riley and his team were polite, professional and helpful in explaining what they had installed. The independent electrical safety inspector/auditor when he visited commented on how neat and tidy the installation was done to the applicable Australian Standards.
Thanks guys for such a professional job. The pride in the workmanship can be seen in your completed work. Thanks again .Trevor and Linda

We took our time to review the received quotes and settled on Solargain as we felt their solution was one of good quality and met our needs. The install happened fairly quick following them given the go ahead and the installers were very proficient with the job completed in approx 7hrs. The final inspection took approx 1 week before we were live and another week for our meter to be re-configured. The app tells us we are using the grid between 50 to 60% less than pre-solar so are very interested in seeing our next bill!
Quoting process was a mission.Installers were professionals, very tidy and efficient, overall excellent job.

Custom Solar Power responded quickly and arranged a home inspection straight away. Michael arrived well-prepared with all the details about my existing solar setup and explained how a solar battery would work, keeping it simple, which I really appreciated, as I find the technical specs very overwhelming. Communication was great throughout, and I was kept up to date with the installation schedule. The team was punctual, tidy, and did a very neat job. They also showed me how to use the charger in an easy-to-understand way. Very happy with the service, professional, efficient, and friendly!

Custom Solar Power was great from start to finish. Zaren was more than happy to answer all my questions about the system without a fuss.You can get a cheaper install elsewhere but you'll pay for it in half a decade. The installation was phenomenal, extremely clean and tidy and really quick considering everything.I'd recommend these lads to anybody if you want a premium install and peace of mind.

Cant give CSP team enough praise, best quoting process, best quote, best installation, best after installation customer service.All CSP staff are enthusiastic and committed to providing the best product and service to support your energy needs. I had additional solar panels and battery installed, they were punctual, quick, neat and happy to show me how my system worked.The CSP developed software to assist with selling power to the grid is exceptional.  Their support with my learning curve was and is highly admirable.

The whole process from sales to installation and commissioning was professional and efficient. They were patient and informative answering many questions and revising my quote quite a few times as I changed my mind on equipment. Installers were great, did a tidy job, and fullfilled all of my requests regarding installation specifics like inverter location, cabling routes, moved a conduit I realised would clash with future works without fuss. They then ran me through everything once commissioned and made sure I had the monitoring app working. System was up and running 100% the day installation was completed, this was instantly reflected in our metered usage the next day. Exceeded expectations and I feel confident about receiving ongoing support should it be required. 100% will be my first call when I want a battery, which can be added very easily now because CSP correctly rationalised the additional cost of a hybrid inverter in the initial solar only installation, the system is already setup for backup which means the battery is virtually a plug in addition and also comes with the benifit of excellent monitoring via the app as the whole house load now runs through the inverter, regardless of if it's pulling from solar or grid.

Initially communication was poor with install date being pushed back and installer not arriving on time. These difficulties were mainly due to factors affecting the battery industry generally outside of Custom Solar Power's control.The installed solution's integrations weren't to my expectation, but CSP then worked hard to provide a solution that I was happy with and continue to work with me until 3rd party integrations are working. The unmet expectations were due to factors outside of CSPs control.Zaren went above and beyond to help customise my solution to what I wanted and continues to be helpful well after the initial install.
Sales/quoting was direct and positiveInstallation went punctual and tidyCustomer service is excellent

Zarren, MD of Custom Solar Power, was very helpful and friendly when he came onsite to quote for our system. He was thorough in explaining the various options available to us and the process and cost involved for each option. (We had spoken to 3 other installers prior to CSP - none had Zarren's in-depth knowledge of the solar industry and his expertise.)On the day of installation, the team arrived on time, and were efficient, polite and professional. The installation process went very smoothly; on completion the team leader explained how the inverter worked and helped to install the app onto my iPad. Indeed, from start to finish it was a seamless experience - I highly recommend Zarren and the CSP team.

Hardware: batteries + new hybrid inverter (Sungrow/Sungrow), Solar panel expansion (Aiko), additional dongle for remote power trading control.Sales/quote: performed an onsite inspection, answered all my questions (I kept thinking of more), and gave thoughtful considerations to all my requests and suggestions (around waste, recycling, panel placement, priorities for environmental impact vs cost efficiency, future proofing, EV expansions - I have a difficult site). Provided quotes in a timely manner, provided all data sheets and warranties for me to peruse. They were realistic about what I could expect, and accommodated my requests. Provided a variety of options for hardware, and for energy provider set ups.Install: Timely, friendly and polite, well resourced with knowledgeable staff on site, put in an extra light in my dark little shed, tidied up everything after. Took away old equipment. Changed over my hot water system (from off peak).Customer service: Answered extra questions and confirmed my preferences again on the day of the install. Performed grid connection. Talked me through different components, switches and trouble shooting and then provided me with photos along with instruction manual. They sent follow up emails to make sure I was happy and everything was working well. They were also careful to time their connections/contracts/install to ensure I was taking advantage of the battery rebate.Energy trading: They set up a dongle and helped me assign them permission to trade on my behalf. They set up sensible initial parameters for battery and AEMO spot price trading decisions. I didn't realise that they would be in touch again - but they emailed me to let me know when my inverter connection had cut out, then called me soon after to follow up and make sure I'd been able to fix it, and then rediscussed my energy usage, and made plans to tweak their algorithm to make my trading efficiency even better. They micro manage for me, but there is flexibility if I want to change things manually, and I can watch everything in the Sungrow app.Based on their recommendations, management, and installation, I am approximately $600-700 better off per quarter than I was before with Origin energy as a provider, no battery, and a smaller panel array. By bill for the first 29 days was -$59.35. 2 months after the installation, and they are about to tighten up the trading parameters based on my data so far.

The quoting service showed a lot of patience with my detailed requests and changes in specificationsThe installation was very professional and the finish looks neat and cleanThe whole process was excellent from first contact to finished product
During quoting stage, Ryan ably answered my queries and kept us informed all along the way. Very happy with the result.

As the title says, Once again RLE Group do a fantastic job.  June 2024 Ryan installed a solar system for us 19.8kW 3 phase with SMA inverter - go check my review.This time I was looking to add a battery, like every other person in the country after the Govt rebate.  Originally I had toyed withthe idea of adding some RUiXU batteries as they looked at good price point - but were waiting for CeC approval.Ryan said with the Govt rebate Sigenergy was a good option, so I spent some time investigating.  Brilliant!  Ryan came to the party and gave me quotes for 16 & 24 kWh options.  In the end I went with 32kWh and the install was done with no issues.  So now I have my SMA AC coupled with my Sigenergy/SigStor giving me heaps of electrons.Yesterday was a nice day and my SMA spat out 98.8 kWh of electrons.  I sold 66.37 to the grid and got $6.63 the grid sold me $0.11 - Happy with that.Ryan did a great job with his team.  He certainly knows what he is doing.  Look no further.

Had previously installed solar panels & on this occasion the install was a solar battery. Very happy with install process. Quick & smooth, now just waiting for first power bill to check out the savings. Happy to recommend.

Evo Solar quoted for 2 systems, we went for the dearest system 34 solar panels & the Tesla powerwall 3 to go with the 20 panels we had already installed. Cameron explained the difference between the 2 systems. Cameron came & inspected the house on the 4th of October & the installation was two weeks later on the 18th of October. The installation took two days. Was going to be a thursday & friday, but because of bad weather thursday was cancelled & they came back on the sunday to finish off the installation. Inspector checked & ok'd the installation the next friday. Grid connection is not approved yet as communication between tesla & powercor regarding "Emergency Backstop process" is still ongoing. When they receive confirmation from tesla & powercor they will complete the grid registration. Customer service great I have been kept up to date with the whole process by email & use of charger is easy with the Tesla  App.

The sales process was quick and easy. Cam explained everything really well and provided all options.The install was really good. Communication was amazing and the guys on site were polite and left my garage clean and tidy.The grid connection was done in the same week and was straightforward.After the battery was turned on any questions were answered .Overall 5 stars

Travis and his co-worker arrived a little earlier than scheduled and got to work straight away. Five hours later my Tesla Powerwall-3 and Gateway were installed and working. The installation is neat and tidy and the area thoroughly cleaned up. I had a few concerns about the location of the Powerwall  These were quickly dispelled by Travis who adapted the location to my satisfaction. In all I am extremely satisfied with the service proved by EVO including the site visit by Cam, quotation and the work completed by his crew. Now we look forward to our system working as planned.

Absolute rubbish and the worst idea I have ever had.Cost over 10000$My bill has gone from 600$ per quarterTo over 800$ per quarterSalesman treated us like mushrooms and fed us a heap of bs to get the saleEmpty promisesCannot recommend this company at all.Get some other quotes not this mobFinancially worse off.

Arrived when he said he would, only took 2 weeks from start to installation.Fast and neat install, friendly crew and Arthur was very good with communication. We had a small issue and he promptly came back and fixed( within a couple of hours on a weekend!)Arthur seems to genuinely want to install a system that suits your expectations as if he was installing his own system.Very happy with the process from start to finish and they managed to supply a larger system than I originally looked for a the lowest price, so great bang for buck, at this stage very pleased with my solar and battery installation

If you value honesty, reliability, and communication, I urge you to stay far away from this company.Their team initially confirmed an installation date weeks ago. No one showed, not even a call to let us know that they weren't coming. Since then, I have been misled on every occasion, repeatedly assured they would follow up, only to be left hanging every time. About 19 emails and phone calls—often ignored or met with inaccurate promises of calling back and even hang-ups. It’s impossible to get anyone to respond.This is not just a scheduling issue. This is a company that disregards its own customers and basic service commitments. If this is how they treat customers before the job is even started, I can only imagine the nightmare if anything ever goes wrong with the install or system.Do yourself a favour and find another provider that actually values your time, communication, and trust. I wish I had known—don’t make the same mistake I did.
Very easy and quick quote. Installation was done a month before the proposed date. Really proffezional installers

Paid the deposit for my system in June after being bombarded by calls and emails. System hasn’t been installed and nobody wanted to answer me. Was told 3-4 weeks ago I would receive a refund on my deposit but now nobody in the company wants anything to do with me.

My experience with Solar Power Nation has been a complete failure from start to finish, and I am now forced to recover my deposit through a formal complaint with Consumer and Business Services SA.The sales process felt rushed, with pressure to sign my contract before the end of the financial year to "lock in prices" on a 10.56kW Risen panel system with a Sigenergy battery. I paid the dollar deposit on June 27, 2025.What followed was months of silence. The company completely missed the installation target date and the final deadline in our contract, with zero proactive communication.After I repeatedly chased them for an update, they finally admitted in September that they could not supply the system in the contract, citing "unavailability and price unsureity". This directly contradicts the "locked-in price" promise that was used to pressure me into signing. It's clear the equipment was never secured.In the same email, they offered a refund of my deposit. I accepted immediately and provided my bank details as they requested.Since then, they have failed to pay the refund. They have ignored my follow-ups and are now unlawfully withholding my money.This company has failed on every level: sales integrity, project management, customer communication, and basic contractual obligations. They took my deposit for a system they couldn't deliver and are now refusing to return it.I have lodged a formal complaint with Consumer and Business Services SA to recover my funds.Based on my experience, I cannot recommend Solar Power Nation. I strongly advise anyone considering them to be extremely cautious.

The initial sales process with this company was good, with a fast and proactive sales person.  But then the install date went and passed without any communication from them.  By the way, that is a breach of their contract.  I have followed up many times, and they just provide excuses.  It seems they have trouble getting stock. Now I have a new install date for a different system, and even though the date is approaching they are still not communicating. Unfortunately it looks like I will need to get legal to get my deposit back and go elsewhere
Approachable and helpful with choosing the most suitable system for our needs. Great price.  Easy installation process. Highly recommend.
as the above comments have detailed will be talking to sundrop when i think i need a battery

Right from the start , getting information and quotes , Kevin was very helpful and explained everything to me .Very happy with their service and installation was very professional and they cleaned up after they had finished

The initial education from Solarquotes was really helpful, even for myself as an electrical engineer who does not work in the field of renewables. Solarquotes was able to recommend two firms for my area in Perth. Sundrop Electricals were able to answer all my questions, and they have a good level of technical knowledge on domestic solar systems. From all of my enquiries, I received 2 quotes, mostly due to businesses being too busy and also not too interested as I wasn't buying a battery system as well. I chose the Sundrop Electricals' proposal for the combination of Jinko panels and the 10 kVA Fronius Gen24 Inverter.All interaction required with our energy provider was done by the Sundrop team, so the process was easy.The installation process was consultative, and the workmanship is of a high level. All of the team was polite and due to the size of the team, it only took 6 hours. The system handover and supplied documentation were done well. There was no hurry to just abandon me with the new system. I have received all required electrical notices from the regulator and they initiated the energy retailer processes as well.I can recommend Sam and Shane from Sundrop. They are passionate about renewable energy and take pride in their work and business.

Other installers sent quotes without vsiting our home.  Sam from Sundrop was great, he explained his quote, checked that our tiles (which are quite old) we in good condition to allow installation of the panels and talked through our options.  We actually chose a more expensive solution than he recommended just because we wanted total integration with our vehicle charging, and Sundrop did not push this solution.Sam has been responsive and completed all work as scheduled.  He connected everything through the wifi app and registered and setup everyhting for us, including the car charger.We highly recommend Sundrop and Sam to any prospective solar customers..

Shane and his team were punctual polite and respectful. They worked diligently completed the installation and cleaned up the debris. I have no hesitation in recommending Sundrop to people looking for quality.

Sundrop Electricals provided expert advice in an easy to understand manner and installed a fit for purpose system for us. They were cost competitive, used quality components and made the whole process straightforward. We have already recommended them to family.

The quotation process with Kevin went very well.Shane and his team arrived on time for the installation, all installed quickly and efficiently.Shane setup the Sungrow inverter app on my phone.So, in all a very good experience with Sundrop Electrical.

Gave good quote explaining my choice in quality and price. No issue with installation which was done promptly and surprised by how quick it was done. excellent after service provided where they completed all relevant paperwork.

We have been putting off getting solar for a long time. But a chat with Sam changed our minds. He went over the details, very thorough and was patient in answering all our questions. Thanks Sam and Shane for your professionalism and excellent customer service!

Really knowledgeable sales person who was happy to answer all of our questions. Quick turnaround from quote to install.Installation crew was very impressive, it was clear they had a lot of pride in their work and in providing a high quality service.Grid connection was done straight away.Very impressed with their service, quality of work and fast turnaround. Highly recommended!

The sales quoting process was very efficient and detailed. The installation team were punctual, polite and very efficient. They did all the ‘go between’ paperwork between us and the energy supplier. They were very patient in explaining how the system works and answered all questions. Very impressed with this company and would certainly recommend them to others.

When we first inquired with HELCRO ELECTRICAL PTY LTD we were genuinely impressed by Fedya’s expertise and problem-solving approach. After listening carefully to our requirements, he provided several options for the upgrade we wanted and picked up a potential problem with one of the existing inverters handling the amps needed for the back-up battery. He immediately checked with the original company to confirm and then promptly sourced and planned the installation.HELCRO ELECTRICAL’s in-house team of qualified electricians, including Rhys and apprentice Mark, work efficiently with a thorough attention to detail. Fedya and his team replaced the new inverter in the same position as the old one without any need for remodelling or patching holes. It’s clear this is a team of people who take pride in their work.    Fedya is excellent in communicating throughout the process so that you know what to expect. On completion of the installation, Fedya programmed the system and linked us with the app enabling us to monitor the solar production of energy and discharge of the battery system in real time. We were given clear instructions how to use the system in case of an energy blackout. The inspection of the system was also organised promptly and no changes were required because of the high quality of the work by HELCRO ELECTRICAL’s professional team.From the beginning, Fedya’s experience and attention to detail meant the process of upgrading our existing solar system to include a back-up battery was precise, organised and thorough. We can highly recommend HELCRO ELECTRICAL PTY LTD for their quality installation and timely, courteous service.Renate and Mohamad

Once the blockage caused by a lack of system availability following the government rebates opening up cleared, we got our system and it was installed. During the waiting time HDC kept us informed about what was going on and actually came out to complete as much setup work as possible before the battery and inverter arrived.When everything arrived, they came later that week to install all the gear. They worked long days to try to get everything done as quickly as possible but seemed a cheery crew all the same. They dealt well with our non-standard highly insulated home.Everything is neat, not covered in stickers and seems to be running very well for the first few weeks.

We are delighted with the entire experience provided by HDC Solar & Electrical for the installation of our new solar array, Sigenergy battery, gateway, and EV charger. We found HDC through the Solar Quotes website, and they exceeded our expectations at every stage.Outstanding Sales and Planning:Danielle was exemplary in the initial sales process. She genuinely listened to our requirements and goals, including our specific needs for the system's financial performance with our variable energy plan. Her expertise ensured the chosen system was perfectly sized and correctly quoted for our property. The site visit was thorough, easing any concerns we had about the installation process, especially the integration with our existing setup.Professional Installation and Team:Aiden and his installation team were well-presented, friendly, and highly professional. They worked quickly and efficiently over the two days required for the panels, battery, and EV charger installation, even when facing unexpected challenges on the house.Unheard-of Aftercare and Follow-Up:The commitment to service did not end when the bill was paid. We experienced a minor hiccup between the new Sigenergy system and our existing GoodWe solar array, requiring the team to return a couple of times. Not only were they happy to address the issues, but they also prioritised resolving them promptly.This dedication was backed up by Renee, the General Manager, who called several times to ensure our issue was being sorted, and Danielle continued to check in afterwards. This level of service is truly unheard of in the industry today.The System and Recommendation:The Sigenergy 24 kWh battery, gateway, and EVAC system are exceptional; they look fantastic and operate flawlessly. We are extremely glad we chose this premium brand and, crucially, this expert installer.We would wholeheartedly recommend HDC Solar & Electrical. They couldn't have done a better job of delivering on their promise of quality and professionalism.

Very happy with HDC. Throughout the process they were clear, honest and transparent with their proposal. Installation happened quickly thanks to a well-organised installation team, and all of my follow-up questions were responded to quickly.
Gedlec went out of business with outstanding work to do.
Great company to deal with, Everything was done in a timely manorGreat product and very professional electrician, shame he lives so far away or we would have him do all our electrical work.

Bills are now more expensive than prior to the installation.When asking for help nothing is ever done.I have been asking for 3 months to get codes to log into my equipment supplied.I still have no response. After many requests.Just the fact I will not contact me at all is a major red flag.

Energy Assist (Mike & Juliette) originally supplied my Solar and Inverter, I was familiar with the sales team. The quotes provided from other suppliers were comparable.  I chose Energy Assist because I had used them previously and they provided excellent after sales service for my solar (& also my mother’s solar we used them for her installation also).  I decided to upgrade my inverter to the same company as the battery - SigEnergy.  The installation team did an efficient job in installing the new inverter and battery.  I was originally schedule for mid December, however an opening came up earlier so my battery has now been installed ahead of proposed time.

We were adding a battery and appropriate inverter to an existing 10kW solar system. There was no up-selling or jargon involved and they provided direct, honest advice that respected our budget. we were able to talk to their senior electrician to fully understand our options, and the installation was a masterclass in professional customer relations and old school tradesmanship. The site was spotless when they finished. The independent commissioning and certification was seamless thanks to the friendly office staff, and we have exactly the system we wanted, fully operational in less time than we initially expected. Their price was the best, even adding extra work on the switchboard to enable us to leave the grid very easily, when ready.

Easy & quick response to obtain advice and quotation.Excellent installation process.  Great team who left the property clean & tidy.Company is very hands on providing emails with clear instructions on the  process and next steps, plus who does what and when. Electrical Inspection has just been completed so expect the electricity provider to reconfigure the meter next week. It’s been a seamless process so far.

Mike was helpful with the quotes answering as many questions that I had. It is still important to educate yourself (such as learning from solar quotes website) and know what battery storage and inverter power options you have the pros and cons.The installers did a good job on the install of a Sigenstor system and behaved in a professional manner.So far I have I have not needed to contact customer service but they are available to answer any questions through Phone and email.
They were very flexible with what I wanted , and were able to meet my needs with no fuss .Very pleasant and easy to deal with
Signed contract 4 weeks ago and awaiting installation. It is expected that installation will occur within 5-8 weeks from date of contract.

The final criteria was being able to supply and install quality kit within our reasonable budget.On all counts, Oslec Energy met these. Their personable Managing Director conducted the site visit, after having first read our written brief. He evaluated our shading issues, roof area and location for the inverter and storage battery. On commissioning the set up, to be expected, there were a few early teething issues. With the help of Oslec, each were resolved. We could have purchased a similar system for less from other vendors, but as the old adage states - long after the price is forgotten, the quality remains. If you are looking to install a new or upgrade an existing system, we recommend you consider Oslec Energy as one of your options at least.

Okay I’m revising my original review of Stag Electrical. The reason is while my angry rant made me feel better it wasn’t particularly helpful to others. I now recognise Stag was incredibly naive and unrealistically complacent rather than necessarily incompetent. And I have to accept that more assiduous work on my part may have helped to avoid the shambles this became.Just a recap: I sought quotes through SolarQuotes near the end of April 2025, and received 3 referrals. I ordered a Powerwall 2 and paid the deposit to Stag Electrical in early May. This was to be the second Powerwall for my system. No other battery (including other Tesla batteries) was compatible. If I failed to secure a Powerwall 2 then I was stuck with a substandard solution for the foreseeable future. Tesla ceased production of Powerwall 2s in 2024 and old stock was rapidly disappearing. On top of that the federal government had introduced the battery rebate! And in Canberra there were rumours that the government interest-free solar loans were going to cease on 30 June (which in fact did occur); while I wasn’t getting a loan this promoted even more demand for batteries. This was the proverbial perfect storm and to say it made me nervous is an understatement.I contacted all who quoted and expressed my concerns about my fear of Powerwall 2s disappearing in the frenetic buildup to the start of the federal battery rebate. They agreed with me and said they would bring  a Powerwall 2 into their stock as soon as I paid the deposit. One reason I am modifying my review is that I can’t recall Stag Electrical making that specific undertaking. I had assumed anyone who worked in the industry as long as Stag would do the same as other suppliers and physically secure the stock. But I don’t recall explicitly asking for this. My bad number one.I still think Stag could have, with minimal effort, secured a Powerwall 2 battery rather than rely on reserving one with a wholesaler who was obviously going to be under immense pressure to satisfy an unprecedented demand for stock to desperate installers. Just about everyone in the industry had predicted this. And Powerwall 2s were special in my case because I could not expand my system with any other battery.The second area where Stag let me down was implying my Powerwall was available in each of my follow-up phone calls. They were even offering assurances to me in June, although apparently now saying they found out (in July admittedly) that Powerwall 2s ceased to be available in May. I accepted those undertakings, again based on my previous dealings with Stag and SolarQuotes endorsement of them. My bad number 2.So on 1 July I was waiting for the call from Stag to tell me when my installation would occur. The call I got on 14 July was that Stag could not source a Powerwall 2 even though they had been trying for the past 2 weeks. I was not a happy camper to find out that not only had they not secured stock but had also been giving me assurances for the past 2 months that everything was on track. I may have overreacted a little.While the result was initially devastating for me, I have to concede that I could have been more explicit and rigorous in keeping Stag on track, and have to accept that.I still think Stag should have, as an experienced operator in the industry, done more to secure a battery without the need for a customer to constantly hassle them. But lessons learned.Just because an installer has provided good service in the past there is no guarantee they will continue to do so.SolarQuotes endorsement of an installer is a low bar and due diligence requires much more than relying on that.

I am writing to raise several serious concerns regarding the installation and service of my solar system completed by Aussie Hybrid Solar (AHS).1. Incorrect Inverter ConfigurationOur property has a three-phase power system, but AHS team installed two single-phase inverters. This setup caused one phase of our home to continue drawing power from the grid. Their response stated that the use of two single-phase inverters complies with Australian electrical standards and installation requirements, and that I may consult a third party directly. However, compliance with standards does not automatically mean this configuration is appropriate for my system design or usage needs. The installation outcome clearly indicates an imbalance and inefficient utilisation of generated solar power.2. System Activated Before Meter ReplacementAHS team turned on the solar system immediately after installation, before the new smart meter was installed by the energy company. I specifically confirmed with their staff at the time whether it was okay to use solar power right away, and was told “yes.” However, I later discovered that my solar production was feeding into the grid without being recorded, meaning I was effectively sending power to the grid for free while still being charged for grid electricity. This caused my electricity bill to increase significantly instead of decrease. I am uncertain about the exact regulatory requirements, but I believe this practice is improper and misleading to customers.3. Failure to Address Off-Peak Controller ConnectionIn my switchboard, there is a main switch and an off-peak controller located together. AHS installers did not consult me regarding whether I wanted to remove the controller and connect it back to the main switch. They only connected the solar system to the main switch. As a result, part of my home’s electricity usage was excluded from the solar system, continuing to draw power from the grid. I was unaware of this issue until another company came to install a battery and pointed it out.Although I am still within the five-year warranty period, AHS company has repeatedly emphasised that their responsibility ended after installation. I have experienced unprofessional service and poor after-sales support. AHS staff advised me to contact an “authorised third party” to provide evidence, yet they did not specify who this third party is. They also ignored the issues raised by my licensed electrician.Due to these unresolved problems, I have lodged a complaint with NSW Fair Trading and will now have to organize a qualified electrician at my own cost to correct the installation issues.

Had a small issue with an inverter fan that was sorted out in a day with no fuss.Cant fault these guys.  Highly recommend.

From initial contact with Solar4Life to completion of the battery installation, the process was smooth and efficient.  I particularly appreciated two site visits to discuss how the battery and back-up gateway would be installed and how it would integrate with the existing solar/inverter system.  Installation was completed and commissioned expertly.  The whole team (sales, engineers, installers) kept me informed and were punctual at every stage.

Anil was great to deal with and suggestions were sensible allowing me to choose. Everything from quote to installation went smoothly. He worked around his schedule and arranged installations at a time that suited me and everything went as discussed. S4L was recommended to me by a couple of friends who had installations without any issues and my experience was also great and hassle-free. I would recommend them highly.

We were impressed with the service from start to finish. The installation went smoothly and the customer service provided by Ranjeet and Anil was excellent. We were pleasantly surprised by how stress free the whole process was! Thank you Solar4life!

Over the past 4 years Solar4Life have installed my solar system, ceiling insulation and most recently a 40kw battery and matching suitable inverter.  From start to finish the process for each job has been perfect!  The knowledge of the sale team is amazing - they were genuinely interested in finding me a solution for what I wanted, at a very good price point.  The team is always polite and professional.  Installation was on time and everything worked perfectly, with all of my questions answered and  site left clean and tidy.  I definitely recommend Solar4Life.

I worked with Anil, the business development manager, from the outset. I also had two other quotes, and Anil was most people friendly. He gave me all the advice leading to efficient overhaul of a system I had, including a 13 year old SMA micro inverter system which was beginning to slow down. Following his visit, I ended up with a 32 KWA Sigen system and a Sigen EVAC charger with nearly 20 kw solar panels on my roof (including what I already had). For the last three days even when sun is only partially visible, I am 99% on solar, including charging my Geely EX5. We have Sanden heat pump for water heating and heat pump air-conditioning throughout.Yes, we had small issues with inking the charger to the system but a visit by a keen helper sorted all out. I already had solar and all approvals were arranged without fuss and all my meter box connections and circuit breakers were upgraded to new AUNZ standard. All for the price equal to one of the other quotes I received which had no new panels or charger.They were polite, not trying to convince me that they are the best, punctual and kept the place tidy after all the work.I cannot be happier.

Dealing with Solar4Life Canberra has been a pleasure. From first contact through quoting, ordering, installation and commissioning of my Sigenergy system. Solar4Life has gone above and beyond being helpful. Communication has been good, the installation team were efficient and the quality of the installation is first class.

Anil was fantastic to work with. I made regular changes to my quote request, increasing the size of the batter each time, and Anil was happy to change the quote each time, responding quickly. The quote was very well priced. Fortunately I got in before the mad rush and was able to have the installation done in the first few days of July. The installation happened on the day it was planned for and virtually everything done that day. This system was fully functional that day. There were a couple of minor tasks remaining which were done two weeks later. I am very happy with my system and the quality installation job. I can definitely recommend Solar4Life.
I recently had a solar panel and battery package installed and have been very happy with the advice and service I received. Highly recommended.

I had 48kwh of sigenergy batteries installed, along with a 10 kw sig inverter and gateway, an EV charger, an istore heat pump HWS and a new induction cooktop. Solar4life staff were very knowledgeable and helpful. Best priced quote (by a significant amount) out of the three companies recommended by solarquotes website. Company owner was extremely helpful and flexible to changing requirements and I’m  glad that I followed his suggestion and installed sig batteries rather than BYD. The install staff were excellent, they were on-time, fast, professional and friendly and put in extra effort above the work that was quoted.  Overall a great experience and I highly recommend Solar4life.

The Sales proposal was very prompt and very responsive to changes required. The sales representative eas very professional and knowledgeable with comprehensive system and its installation based on my requirementsThe installation of the system happened on the date and time as was agreed. The installers were very friendly and executed the installation in a professional manner without any mess left.The customer service was very good and activated the live monitoring of the system within specified time without any hassel. The live monitoring is simple to use using the invertor mannufacturers app.I would recomend Solar4Life based on the service they have provided.

I contacted Solar4Life on a whim, pretty sure I was going to go with a quote from one of the big shiny company's that promote online. How absolutely, incredibly pleased I am that I didn't. Solar4Life did a like for like quote and were 10% cheaper (Powerwall 3, Solar, etc). Anil also provided alternate quotes for me, lots of different options, as I revised and revised what I wanted, he has the patience of a Zen master! Fast forward to when I eventually made up my mind, I was all ready to go and Labor announced their battery incentive. Anil immediately suggested we wait as it would be a massive saving for me (despite the massive hit to his cashflow). So I did. Now fast forward to 4th July, it's all installed and I just love it (more than one should love a metal box of electricity). The quality of install is absolutely without question, nothing, and I mean nothing was difficult for them. There were no extra charges. I even changed the location to inside my garage meaning a bollard, a hard wired smoke detector, longer wiring, no extra charge! One last example, we also got the DC EV charger installed,  I had noticed on Sigen's website that they were promoting an installer offer of buy 5 get 6th free. Thought not much of it. Just today, Anil sends the final invoice and it notes "20% discount on DC EV charger due supplier bonus". Honestly, you cannot fault Anil or the team came out, Jimmy, Babu, Saab, Goodchan and the others, thank you (and sorry for definitely misspelling your names). Oh, we're in Wollongong and they were happy to travel here.

Anil provided a competitive quote, did an on-site visit with his experienced panel installer (Saab) to verify layout before the final quote. The panel installers did a great job damaging only 1 tile for 42 panels, the Jimmy their electrician did a thorough and neat job with the sig 3phase inverter, stack and gateway.All in all, a very good experience from a great team.

I received quotes from 3 suppliers recommended through SolarQuotes system and additionally from RLE for which organisation I had a personal recommendation.The quality of all the quotes was good and the range provided me with a level of understanding of options and costs that was very useful in making a decision.RLE and one other supplier made site visits to establish their initial quote which I found helpful as I had particular issues with locating of the solar panel on the roof for ongoing access to clean gutters and for how the wiring would be discretely located.  All the proposals were of a similar cost and content. RLE was not the cheapest proposal however I felt it provided a good quality system and the service level I wanted.The RLE installation team were courteous and efficient. The installation was completed as scheduled. They guys carefully addressed my concerns for discrete wiring and provided helpful advice on the system and the app.With the SolarQuotes recommended suppliers' proposals and the quality service and installation of RLE the whole process was much easier than I anticipated.
Very happy with Qld Commercial Solar. Mark was informative, listened to me and was easy to deal with. Communication was very good. Installers were punctual,  professional and friendly.

Sales/quoting process was flawless, but would have been good to have a face-face at time if quoting.Happened on my request for more information later.Installation went flawlessly. Installers were very informative and helpful on completion.
The whole process was easy and efficient. The communication throughout was excellent. Everything was clearly explained. I was happy with the price.

Sales and quoting: We worked with Andrew from Goulburn Solar throughout the quote process. We were going from no solar and high electricity and petrol bills, to full solar with an EV. We wanted to achieve a solar installation that would supply our average daily energy needs of approximately 60kWH/day and do it in a way that maximises our solar use. We were also slightly constrained as we are only on single phase grid supply, and there was some complication as our meter box was about 40 metres from our main house which has a sub-board of a main board attached to our garage, and two separate storage hot water systems which were relatively new. Andrew spent plenty of time thinking about the best way to install things to maximise the return off investment. This included a large Deye single phase inverter, Catch Solar relays to divert energy to hot water, a Wallbox EV charger, and some Dyness batteries. Given there were some relatively unknown Chinese brand names involved, Andrew got us comfortable around the support and service available.Installation: It went perfectly. Caroline came out a few weeks before and surveyed the site and confirmed everything would work fine. On installation day, the electrician in charge of the install, Quinton, let me know when the team would arrive…and boy did they arrive! An army of installers arrived to beat some oncoming weather and worked together like a well oiled team. We had 23.66KW of panels installed in a half day, but it wasn’t a rushed job. The team kept me apprised of how they would do the install and any considerations to make it work best. Everyone was so friendly and professional - always a good thing to see a team get on well and enjoying what they do. Also left the place clean and tidy (unusual for electricians - speaking from experience here!)Customer service: great! Our install was a little bit leading edge, and knew it might need some fine tuning as we went along. But the team made it clear they were there to support. We had some teething issues with our battery not talking to the inverter, and some fine tuning needed on the Catch Solar and EV charging. But Andrew and Quinton were always there to help troubleshoot and sort things out. I should say that the core solar functionality has been bulletproof and worked perfectly - everything else has just been fine tuning on a complex install and we’ve never been left without power and resolution has always been prompt.Hami and Richard arranged grid connection and all our rebates were processed seamlessly. Quinton showed us how to use everything. And both Andrew and Quinton were able to answer my many, many questions. It’s always refreshing to hear someone say “That’s my job” and understand how comfortable you need to be when playing with electricity and big bucks!Finance: We used a Plenti green loan through Goulburn Solar. Plenti had some pretty clunky loan application processes but Richard and Andrew helped us through, and escalated when Plenti erroneously knocked us back for finance. Got a great rate which meant that the cash flow impact was no more than our existing electricity bill, and can pay off early with no early payment fee. Very transparent arrangements from Goulburn Solar as well.

I accepted a quote for a 6.6kw system on a single phase house. Upon the site inspection it was found that my mains wires to the street would have to be increased, Goulburn solar then enabled me to choose to upgrade my house to a 3 phase supply (a tripling of supply) as part of future proofing my house for electrification (EV, AC, Induction cooking).The install went smoothly with an exceptional quality work, much to my surprise even up in the back corner of the roof the cables and conduit are tidy. Contrary to popular misconceptions about electricians they cleaned up after. They were accomodating with my questions and were able to explain everything to me. As I got the three phase supply the inverter also had to be changed to a three phase unit, watch out here though as fronius doesn't support full backup on their small three phase inverters, I should have chosen a larger inverter but thankfully they have a PV point output and it can power small loads with or without a battery.This is the part where it got bumpy as there isn't a clear easy process to get the energy authority's meter changed over to 3phase and requires a third-party metering company to install the meter (none of this is Goulburn solars fault).Throughout this network meter upgrade process Goulburn solar were very helpful and accomodating, after a couple of months of dealing with the 3rd flaky party installers Goulburn solar were very prompt with the final commissioning and got it all working.The team were very professional and the quality of work is exceptional!Thanks!

Ben was easy to deal with and very helpful in answering questions and taking our calls prior.Nothing changed after we chose Ben as our solar installation company. He was prompt, careful during installation and took all rubbish away.We have now had the system for over a year and we are very happy with it. We managed to get more panels and a better price whilst buying a hybrid Fronius inverter and mid-range panels.Very happy to recommend Solar Concepts and Ben for his customer service, pricing and workmanship.

The installation crew were very efficient, although not the fault of the installers, the system should have a shroud/cover to cover the wires, it looks very untidy between the batteries and the inverter
Gus from MLEC was really helpful in getting the system designed and providing expert knowledge to help us get the right setup for our home.

The sales and quoting process was smooth and hassle-free, which was the main reason I chose MLEC. The installation team was professional and efficient, they handled the grid connection, tested the blackout function, and provided a clear introduction to using the app.

Sales and quoting process was very smooth, the Sales Rep came in personally. He had very good knowledge about the product. Installation was punctual, tidy and polite.  The grid connection was done on the spot by qualified installer and explained very clear.

The sales and quote were quick.  Saleperson was very responsive and helpful.  Installation was quick and without hassle, no fuss.  The solar system started working well and the installer ran everything through with us.  And everything has worked well so far.

So far I have only paid a 10% deposit. The design engineer made every effort to improve the number and distribution of solar panels on my difficult roof style to achieve an adequate daily power output even in winter. I wanted solar panels mainly to charge my ev and heat my water. The system does not include a battery.

We had a 15Kw system featuring Aiko panels and Enphase inverters installed by Paul and the team at Guwing Green.Paul gave us detailed and thorough responses to all the questions we had when deciding on what components to useand he was happy to update the detailed proposal on each iteration of our plan.The installation process was pain free as Scott, Josh, and the team made the work look easy and the whole thingwas completed well within the day.I'm delighted with the system and my favourite pastime now is watching the system perform via the Enphase app.

Very disappointed with this company. I had a job cancel unexpectedly, and was told the company is now bankrupt, yet their ads are still appearing online. I would advise anyone to stay well clear of this company.
Got our 30 Kw Esy battery done. Working perfectly fine. Excellent customer service and backup support is good.
It is always great to do business. The quality is great, support is awesome. I'll don't have to worry about anything.

From the beginning, communication has been prompt and helpful. We needed strata by-laws changed and Sam at Your Green Planet liased with strata and helped facilitate the changes.The installation was done on time and it looks great.

Your Green Planet installed my system in May 2023. Just got a battery installed a week ago.From start to finish whole process went very smoothly. The staff is great and very knowledgeable . Highly recommended.

SolarGain installed a full suite of 13kw solar panels with accompanying batteries as part of my new build. They did a fantastic job and were very knowledgeable, professional and helpful, particularly given I am not an expert in this area and was relying upon SolarGain to set me up with the right solution for my specific needs (which they did). They also provided excellent after sales service when one of the products failed (through no fault of SolarGain). Bryn (SolarGain CEO) became personally involved and helped broker a great outcome with the manufacturer. I would highly recommend.

From first contact we were very at ease with SolargainThe team said what they would do and when then followed throughCommunication was ongoing and very efficientThe installation team were very prompt polite and professionalWould highly recommend Solargain to anyone

The sales person provided me some good advice on various inverters and provided me a few different quotes until we found one I was comfortable with.Installation went smoothly and the installers did a good job.It took over 3 weeks to organise connection to the grid. I was advised this would maybe take a week so I had to chase this up myself for a couple of weeks which was a bit frustrating.
Very happy with system supplied. Battery was an addition to existing solar.
Quoting easy and quickInstallation two weeks after quote, smooth, punctual, tidyEverything organised for us

The quotation process was seamless. The sales manager came out to review the site. Dion and the crew did a great job installing. Had to take a pause due to rain and wind. They were tidy and polite, generally good guys. I still have a few questions about the next steps with my energy supplier.

We installed a sigenergy 24kw battery to our solar system. We went with solarworx as they were the most thorough and informative company.  No question was to hard for them. Always had quick response to any queries. Two weeks after agreeing to contract, had a phone call,  crew was in area and could install the next day. Install crew arrived on time, were very polite and helpful. 4 hours later all finished and cleaned up.  Great service,  great install   great communication.  I would recommend solarworx to anyone needing solar/battery.
Matrix Solar have been fantastic to deal with.  Great customer service, product and price. We would highly recommend them.
Easy to deal with, prompt responses to questions. Installation was quick and painless

A 16kWh SigEnergy battery was added to my existing roof top SolarInstallation were the same crew who installed the solar system.From the first discussion to final commissioning Empower and team were on top of everything.Big thanks to Lindsey in the office and Juan and his team

The sales rep was very helpful. I explained my needs as I wanted full 3 phase backup. His design was excellent.Installation was on time, tidy and was very quick with a team of young men that worked with care.The install was very professional.

I contacted Lindsey via Empower's website, and we corresponded via email and phone and worked through the proposal. My son and I reviewed the technical aspects of a number of quotes and based on Lindsey's support and service, and what we considered to be the best technical outcome, we selected Empower to provide our solar panel and storage package.  The installation was of a very high standard, and the team on site was fantastic-they took us through the system after completing the installation which was really good.Without hesitation, I would use Empower again.

Our solar panel and battery installation with Empower Solar has just been completed, and we couldn’t be happier with the entire experience.From the very beginning, our Energy Consultant, Lindsey Ditfort, has been nothing short of incredible. She took the time to clearly explain every detail of the process in a way that was easy to understand – which was invaluable for someone like me with little prior knowledge. Unlike other companies we had spoken to, Lindsey never pressured us with constant calls or demands for a deposit. Instead, she was patient, approachable, and always willing to answer our many follow-up questions – often spending 20–30 minutes on the phone to ensure we felt confident and well-informed.The installation itself was smooth and well-communicated. The solar panel team was excellent to deal with, working with us to determine the best location and placement for the panels on our roof. The battery installation was delayed due to the state government’s rebate approval process, but throughout that time Lindsey kept us fully updated, regularly checking in and providing honest, timely communication.What truly impressed us was Empower Solar’s commitment to customer satisfaction. When the government rebate delays dragged on, they made the decision to bypass the rebate altogether so that our battery could be installed sooner. Even better, they reduced our quote to match the rebate amount, meaning no additional out-of-pocket expense for us. That level of integrity and customer-first service is rare to find.The battery has now been installed, and we are absolutely thrilled. There was a small issue with minor water damage caused by an unexpected downpour during installation, but even that has been handled seamlessly and without stress on our end.We couldn’t recommend Lindsey Ditfort and Empower Solar highly enough. If you’re looking for a professional, honest, and customer-focused solar company, they are the team to choose.

7.65kW solar panel with 32kWh Sigenergy battery installed 2 days ago.  Since the next morning we havent imported any grid power.  the installation went smoothly and the installers cleared up all their mess.  Highly recommended

Our new solar battery system through Empower is now up and running. From the get-go of enquiries, purchase, installation to operation we have experienced exceptional professionalism and customer service from all the Empower staff and installation contractor.Highly recommend Empower with a BIG shout out to Lindsey from quoting & sales for her 'above and beyond' approach to the highest standard of customer service. The lads from the installation team ensured effective communications throughout the install and cleaned up to expected standards and removed rubbish from site.Overall at each level of the process we were pleased with the service we received and the constant communication and progress streamlined with excellent integration with the energy supplier, application and approval processes. After the sales, it was almost sit back and enjoy the ride. Thank you for such a hassle free experience.Keep up the great work team and we look forward to the benefits of our new system. Thanks Empower Team.
Easy to work with, great service and good price for quality system.

Really helpful, talked me through what the process was and the options available. Then provided a very reasonable quote and was installed not long after. Their team also helped after install to get us connected with the power provider and selling into the grid.

Great company from start to finish. Installation went well, installation team were punctual, polite, left the site very clean and more than happy to explain the installation. Would have no hesitation in recommending these guys

Communication and explanations were second to none. Our concerns were listened to, and detail was down to the smallest things. Follow up contact with more queries from us and general checking in have been greatly appreciated.
The installer is accomodating and genuinely wants to do the best possible job.

We have dealt with Ecoelectric for several years, both with solar panels and recently a new home battery. Jeff and the team are first class, their knowledge is exemplary and we can’t recommend them highly enough.

Quoted and Installed solar panels, but 4 years later the screws they used to secure the brackets to the wall leading to the roof, came away in 3 places. They provide a 10 year warranty on workmanship and installation, but this is worthless as 6 months later I am still waiting for the repair to be done. In my opinion, very unprofessional after multiple calls and emails.
We had a battery installed by these guys and are very impressed. Knowledgeable technicians, high quality install, cleaned up behind themselves, explained the system to us very well. Recommend!

Jack from Open Electrical spent sufficient time with us to explain the finer details of the product they sell, and how he would determine a quote to meet our needs. He is knowledgeable, friendly and genuinely helpful.  Before finalising he advised that he would discuss the quote with his supervisor to ensure it was in order and priced correctly.The installers who spent the day at our property were polite, efficient, helpful and happy to explain what they were doing and adjust the layout of the panels to suit our preference.All in all this was a very productive and welcome experience and we'd have no hesitation in recommending Open Electrical as a reliable and professional solar provider.

The sales and quoting process was informative, logical and respectful. Andrew listened to us and met our expectations and requirements. He also respected and clearly understood the technical aspects of the products. The installation process was efficient and professional. The workmen were all polite and they left the site tidy. Open Electrical handled the grid connection process and we love the software. It's a good feeling knowing that we are doing the right thing by the planet as well as our budget.
Upgraded existing solar system with new Fronius inverter with BYD batteries. Fast quotation, answers all questions with details. Quick and clean installation on the day. Very professional.

Responded promptly to request for a quote. Offered several options with the install giving advice on each option. Once accepted install was carried out very quickly and efficiently. Removing one set of my oldest old panels and adding 18 new panels, battery, Gateway took two days despite illness with part of their team. System was commissioned on morning of day three and it has performed flawlessly since.Installers were friendly and helpful and always had time for any questions. Explained the system and app very well.They were very neat in their work and helped me choose the optimum locations. Nothing seemed a problem for them.They left my property as clean as it was before they came.No hesitation in recommending them.
Process was straightforward. No stressful sales, just good honest information.  Installation team were polite, professional, punctual, tidy and efficient. Neat tidy install.

All questions dealt with.Installation delayed a little, no doubt because of demand, but when started the installers were punctual, friendly and knowledgeable.Customer service fine, showed how to use charger and associated app. Grid connection was automatic following inspection, possibly because it was a replacement array. All documentation provided.

Was called at end of week 5 to offer me 1 day 1 week out. I had charity commitments that day, so they said they would call me back the next week as they can only book 1 week on advance.During the follow up I was given 14 hours notice they needed to complete a second inspection, this was the first time I found out this inspection was required, I moved my schedule around to od my best not to delay in the install.During week 5 I had to threaten to cancel to get any form of commitment of when my install will take place.Install was completed week 7.No install reminderInstaller arrived at 6:59am and left at 7pm.I found out at 7pm they expect me to dispose of all the rubbish. This included- boxes the battery and inverted came in- pallets the panels and battery were delivered on- off cuts / left overs of metal rails, cables, paperwork/manuals- installers lunch containers and drink cansI had to argue regarding the largest pallet (1.5x2m) as it would not fit in my SUV.I spent 4 hours sorting and doing two full trips to the tip to dispose of everything.The quality of the install does look to to be good quality.However during the process I found myself recommending my friends installer, as I could not recommend my experience to people I like.
