review_description: Six years ago with had AHE group install out 10 Kilowatt Solar panels and Inverter.  Now with energy prices still rising we opted to get a Solar Battery installed.  We were very happy last time with Andrew and is crew when they installed our Solar system so we had no hesitation in going back to them for the battery installation. Andrew personally discussed with us our requirements and provided us with a battery solution (24kWh Sigenery battery and 10kW inverter) and quote.On the day Andrew came with his crew and personally installed the system to our existing Solar Panels. They discussed with us the best location to install the Battery and Gateway and we were very happy with the final outcome.  Andrew outlined the display features of the battery and helped us with the App setup and capabilities.  Overall with a very happy with AHE group as they are a family company and pride themselves on their work, customer service and getting it right the first time.  We would not hesitate recommending them to anyone looking for Solar installations.

The entire process was seamless. From the initial review, quote process and installation, it was very smooth and met the expectations provided by AHE. They arrived on time, everything was well installed, and they provided an in-depth training on the various apps required. I would recommend them to anyone.

AHE Group suppliedand fitted our first solar panel systemin 2011. We have just had them upgrade our system to an 11.88kw with battery and its brilliant. Their sales and install team are excellent to deal with and I would definitely recommend them.

10 years ago I got the team from AHE to do a solar PV install for me on my new house build.10.5 KW Of LG solar Panels and a 10kw 3 Phase SMA inverter. Couldn’t have been any happier and the system has operated absolutely flawlessly since then.So when the battery rebate kicked in. I called AHE again and asked them to quote me on an appropriate system. I must say the whole process from design, to quoting to install was deadset flawless. Not only does Andrew and the team know their products inside out but they apply real world use for their installs.Ended up with the Sigenergy Sigenstor 48kw system, an increase of 11 kw of panels and the accompanying Sig EV charger.Install was flawless and efficient. Completed in a day with a full rundown of the product along with answering a plethora of my questions. Not to mention the little added extra surprise of the included automation of some external power devices which I had no clue was even possible!I am deadset wrapped with the install and my new shiny battery!Thanks again to Andrew and the team at AHE!

Andrew and the team at AHE have been great right from the quoting stage to installation. I took a while to decide on the installer and AHE were very responsive and helpful throughout the process.They even assisted with my switchboard upgrades for a great price. Showed up time on the day of the install and completed the job without any issues.They explained to me in detail about the installed system and helped me setup the app on my phone.I would highly recommend AHE to anyone looking to install solar and batteries!!

Andrew Hanna gave very detailed advice about where we could install a solar battery in our terrace, and recommended Sigenergy as the best option for the space we had.The install was completed cleanly and effeciently, with attention to detail that everything was working as expected.I used AHE previously to install our solar system years ago, and they have always been flexible and ready to help. I think their longetivity speaks to the quality of the work and the customer service they provide.

Andrew installed my first solar system around 13 years ago. I had no hesitation in asking Andrew to provide a quote for a battery and solar system to replace the original. I found Andrew, Leanne, Donna and team a pleasure to deal with. From requesting a quote to installation was a breeze. Andrew was always available to provide more information when I had questions. On installation day the team arrived around 8 and I was up and running around 3 including a handover before they left. Even though Andrew wasn't able to be on site for the installation he followed up with a phone call to ensure everything was OK.
Altogether professional good communications and could not ask for better service.

Wow…… what a great experience. Andrew, Leanne and their crew knew their stuff. From the initial call through to install, I knew I was in good hands. They gave a very competitive quote and answered all my numerous questions throughout the entire process without any hesitation, annoyance or eye rolling. On the day of install, Andrew and Sam (Andrew’s son)  were able to redistribute the solar panels on the roof to optimise a greater solar yield and even threw in an extra panel free of charge.After the installation was completed, Andrew showed me how to use the app and also went through a blackout scenario to ensure the system was working properly.I live on the NSW Central Coast and was originally going to go with a local installer however, I would not hesitate in recommending AHE group for any solar and battery installation. Their professionalism was next to none. Thank you

Andrew and team installed our first small system in 2011. It's still going strong. Last Thursday they commissioned our 13kW Jinko array with 48kWh Sigen battery. They arrived at 8am, as promised, and it was up and running by 1pm. The guys take great pride in their work and managed to hide all cables (panels to battery, battery to gateway, gateway to board). The panels from 2011 were cleaned off and the old inverter was plugged into the AC input of the gateway and now provides about 1/7 of total generation. I did get another 3 quotes from Solar Quotes but Andrew was given the job not just because we had worked with him before, he was also the cheapest and did not oversell. (In fact he suggested I get a new car before getting a charger.)  Also, great to work with the same person all the way through (avoiding miscommunication). Better clean up than most tradies we've used. Helpful advice too. For example, I plan to move to Amber (without Smartshift) and he suggested playing with the gateway's various "modes" and get to know these before moving. review_description: I have used Simmark twice so far in 2025 — to install a new Daikin AC system in May and a Sigenergy SigenStor 16kWh home battery in August.As always with this company, I was incredibly impressed with the efforts of its Southern Highlands based tech team. The installer took the opportunity to tidy up a very old board with a modern switchboard and did this at very reasonable cost despite it taking longer than anticipated.Connection to Amber has been very straightforward and I’m seeing the results already.Customer service post install has been very good with follow up calls from them to check everything is working as expected.

SEA were interested in my specific design requirements, and provided good advice on system design.  The price was very competitive.Installation went well, although there was some miscommunication on a variation to the price (due to a long cable run between the battery and switchboard) which led to last minute haggling on price (while the installation was underway).The final presentation of the panels which faced the road was excellent.Initially the battery app which provides info on demand/supply was very flaky which led to some long periods where the app was not working (longest period was 6 weeks).  Responses from SME to solve the problem was often very slow (initial email/phone call responses were very prompt, but it often took a week to a fortnight to get technical support).  A new version of the app has worked well for the last 6 weeks, and there have been no drop outs.

We had a 20kw solar system and 24kwh battery installed through Smart Energy Answers (SEA) by one of their partner companies in Canberra, Summit and Shore Energy.We are really happy with the system, the installation process was smooth on the day, installers were polite, left everything tidy, and explained everything to us. The system is working as intended.The customer service was good too; admin staff at SEA are friendly and punctual with responses.Noting that we understand it is a busy time with the battery rebate and there were some rain delays, there were some things that weren't as smooth as expected, including mixed messaging we received around installation date (different messaging from SEA directly and installer multiple times), our site inspection prior to installation was undertaken by one of SEA's other company partners who didn't end up installing for us, and we requested ethernet connection to the battery/inverter instead of wifi which hasn't been connected yet (although SEA were quick to raise a job to complete this afterwards when we notified them).It was appreciated that they could do the install on a Sunday for us to make sure the job was done on time.Overall we are very happy with the outcome and would recommend Smart Energy Answers and their partner companies.

They wouldn’t come to site to check if the inverter was wired in 240VAC cabling to the fuse box. From the moment we walked into the office we knew that we would be purchasing our Solar system through Circuit Alert. Truly putting us at ease.It was never about our budget, it was abaout what we wanted to achieve by having solar, and how we could protect ourselves from loss of power. Being for a rental property, the process was a little different to the norm, but Circuit Alert navigated everything for me, with no issues.The price of the whole system was exceptional as well!

From start to finish, my experience with Circuit Alert was nothing short of excellent. I am extremely happy with the choice we made. The circuit alert team have installed our solar panels, then more recently (with the subsidy) a battery. Mark and Lisa were always helpful in answering questions (before and after the job) and preparing multiple quotes while we decided on battery size. Installers were polite and gave plenty of information. Panels and battery have worked fine to date (touch wood). Very happy to recommend them.

The whole experience from the initial quote to commissioning of the system has been hassle free and throughly enjoyable. This is solely due to the totally professional manner of everyone we came in contact with. The level of communication and flow of information has been wonderful.Lisa and Martin were our first points of contact and were able to design and supply a system which best suited our needs while staying within our budget.The installation team of Lee and Justin were incredible with a high attention to detail and no shortcuts being taken anywhere. As you can see in the final system install photo a totally neat and clean arrangement, with the many wires and cables out of site within the conduit. The installation team were highly adaptable to address a number of challenges presented to them during the fit out.Additionally the installation team took their time to explain the new wiring and additional switch board configuration due to the three phase system, the shutdown procedure (if required) and the all important system registration and the setup of the system wifi monitoring using the dedicated app.

Very professional, excellent communication back and forth, answered every question I could throw at them. All their answers were straightforward, and if it was something that needed further looking into they would say so and get back to me once they were happy. I was back and forth with them since the beginning of the year on what options were available and once the rebates were actually available in July proceeded with getting final quotes. River, Greg, and Sharon were all great and shout-outs to River in particular since he just started. Final Proposals signed about mid august, with solar and inverter installed beginning of September, battery a couple weeks later once it arrived.Neil and rest of his installation crew were on time on the day, talked through all that had to be done, and walked through all the possible install locations for the inverter and batteries. We ended up putting it in the garage to keep it all out of the sun. Since the inverter was a hybrid system with batteries, I was asked what circuits to put on that backup side - thankfully for me the house was already wired mostly correctly already to have one power circuit for essentials and all light circuits put on backup so that's what was chosen. Once everything was decided they got to work putting up the solar panels, plumber on the heat pump hot water, and getting the inverter installed and running the required cable runs from the meter box to the garage for the inverter feed-in. Everything was cleaned up afterwards, roof sealed, DC cabling in the roof all conduited and labeled, inverter and meter box labelled, and walk through on shutdown procedure with written copy stuck nearby. They ran all their tests and all was well. Came back a bit over a week later and got the battery installed to complete the commissioning.Since then the system has been amazing, more than enough solar generation to meet my needs and the battery is also more than enough to get me through normal night time usage - haven't actually drawn a watt from Western Power!All the grid connection work and documentation was done by Albany Solar for Western Power, the only requirements for me were the sign offs with them.A big thanks to all the crew at Albany Solar, was a great experience!

We are very happy with our new solar panels and the process to get them. Albany Solar was efficient, provided good advice, and made the process very easy. Their installers were punctual, polite and tidy. I would recommend them without hesitation (and have done so already).

Dealt with Sean in SA, was prompt communication, stock of battery on hand, from order to install was about 2-3 weeks. All working well after 2 years. 5 months later I had a 5kw ($7500) battery install too from Battery Solar Group. And had no issue so far.

Rainbow Power Company proved that they were not like so many companies these days that promise and don't deliver. Pinnacle Solar and Batter Installation:From the word go, Sargon was very clear and informative about all the questions we had about the solar installation. Happy with the installation and outcome. We have achieved the level of storage we need. Peak Energy were easy to deal with and installation was quick and efficient.

Our experience with Peak Energy Group (Albury/Wodonga) has been nothing short of fantastic. All the old panels and framing (other than some I said I'd keep for repurposing) were taken away, as was all the packaging from the new system.  Our garage, where the system was installed, was left just as it was found. As we already had grid connection via our old system, the new one was up and running immediately after installation.  We were shown how to use the Sigen app to monitor and customise our system to suit our purposes. Very happy, and the team were great.The customer service after the installation has been flawless and responsive. Now, it is working perfectly.We can highly recommend this company for the great service, efficient installation and the friendly and responsive team.

Could not be happier with the service from the guys and Bridget ,they answered any questions I had, the system was up and running within a day, no problems at all thank you very much guys you're all did a great job

Great process from start to finish. Quality installation and adaptable installer's

Harris Electrical were on the ball right from the start. I spoke with Cooper and discussed what system would suit our needs. They are happy to help and super reliable.

review_description: Very knowledgable and professional design and quoting process.Installation was very professional, courteous and tidy.They did a great job.Customer service was fantastic, showed me how to use the Solaredge monitor, made sure I was happy with everything.They organised grid connection and everything.Answered all my questions when I rang up.I highly recommend Harris Electrical and Solar and Kyle.

review_description: The sales process was great, the installation was delayed because despite taking our money for a Powerwall 3, they had never installed one and they were not yet approved for Victoria. After a few months delay it was all good. The electricians were great and the installation went smoothly. But then the submission of the electrical works Request and post-installation form (DER) to Ausnet is still not complete EIGHT MONTHS LATER. So no feed in tariff and lots of emails from Ausnet threatening to cancel our contract (whatever that means). Numerous emails and phone called to 1Komma5 and still not resolved. I really want to like this company but my patience is wearing thin.
Everything was well explained. Happy with quality of the system. Too early to tell about after sales service yet.
The installers were punctual, polite, and cleaned up afterwards. Very professional.

Sales and quoting were easy, as long as you supply the pictures they ask for you will get a quote very quickly.We had 13.2kw of solar and two Powerwall 3s installed. The installation itself was great. As you can see from the pictures attached to this review the finished product was very clean and tidy.We are still waiting on the inspection so cannot review the performance of the system but everything thus far has been excellent.

The first time the battery kicked in after a short outage, our coffee machine kept setting off the overload switch, they blame the "outage" as the cause and refuse to do anything about the near new coffee machine. They are quite slow to call back when called, and state they are open from 8am. That is QLD time, so in NSW it is 9 am before you can communicate. So, watch your step with these suppliers as things may be not quite what they seem.

The sales process was smooth and completeInstallation team arrived on time and worked tirelessly over two days to set up the system.Now awaiting the Inspector for finalisation which has been organised by 1Komma5.

True warranty horror story - Be afraid of these guysI purchased a 10k solar setup and tesla powerwall 2 7 to 8 years ago.Firstly they installed the solar 7 months later the battery.Big wait times.On install they damaged my roof tiles in 2 place cause water damage to the house.That cost me alot to fix.Nice !!The system worked well for about 2 years saving me a fortune before the battery packed it.They then removed it and I waited another 6 months for replacement.After this it worked well except that about once or twice a week (during summer) it would throw the earth leakage breaker causing all the power to go off.I was told you need to have an electrician look at it, not their problem.Which brings us to about a year ago when the battery stopped working altogether.After dealing with Solaray and now 1komma5, they don't even talk to you, you follow their lodge tickets online and eventually get shunted to a Phillipines call centre who can't help you.I was ignored time and time again.I contacted Tesla who say your installer needs to look at it.The installer call centre kept trying to make me run reboots and wifi setups for 6 months before I got Tesla to pressure them to sent a technician out.Even Tesla said we can see from our end that it's not working and they sent me screen shots of their data to send to the installer (who also has access to the same info already.)When the technician finally came out - he asked me why he was here. He was not even informed of the case progress and after several hours he said - everything is installed properly there's no issue,except your battery is not connecting.I'm like I've been telling you guys this for 1 year already.I said what happens next, he said we will put everything in the report to the installer.I have never heard from them again.They will not respond to emails or phone calls.These are the exact cowboys that will rip you off and not honour the warranty!Btw Tesla also will not honour the warranty - it needs to be done by your installer they say, even though their product is faulty/Stay away from both.PS - Solaray now 1komma5 was an installer recommended from this sites 3 quotes.I had tried to do all I could to pick the right ppl and right gear.Very disappointed - my last winter powerbill was $1250 even having 10k solar.I'm now faced with replacing the whole lot- lucky it has paid for itself 2 years ago.But now I should be enjoying 7 odd years of savings and I'm not!

Had a couple of issues-one was confusion over inverter quotation-later resolved.Also a lack of discussion on inverter options.Later unhappy that deposit was okay on Paypal but remainder owing had to be cash or telephone credit card.Installation went well and performance seems great.

I’ve had a Solaredge inverter and one of their batteries since 2022 it has worked perfectly since installation. Adding a second SolarEdge battery should have been straightforward I thought….Of three installers, 1komma5 were by far the most responsive and offered the best price. They were quick to arrange the install and evaluate the best position.It was a little disquieting to hear the first sub-contractor hadn’t done a SolarEdge battery install before and the left without saying goodbye or how the installation had gone. I looked at my SolarEdge and saw the 2 batteries and thought all was well. That night I paid the final payment.A couple of days passed and I realised that my Amber and SolarEdge apps wasn’t seeing any production. The next week a second subcontractor came out and spent a morning trying to make the system work.Another week and SolarEdge advised the inverter needed to be replaced which would be  done under warranty. This was done by a third subcontractor and after 6 hours the system which had worked perfectly before the second battery was added was still no closer to working. What was more SolarEdge advised it was after the fact reneging on replacing the inverter under warranty.By now I’d have settled for returning the system back to the original as the installer and Solaredge didn’t seem to have a solution to fixing and neither seemed to want to fix the problem.I opened a SolarEdge case on their portal expressing extreme frustration. This was about 4 weeks after having no working system and getting charged higher electricity charges from the Amber wholesale market . No battery and I wasn’t shielded from price spikes.Another week and my case did jolt SolarEdge into doing something. It seems they sent out the wrong replacement inverter and now would replace it with a third under warranty.I’m still waiting for this third inverter to be delivered to the installer whereafter they have promised to come out and install and I hope restore the system. But my confidence in this being the outcome isn’t great but I’m really hoping it can’t get any worse…And to add salt into the wound, SolarEdge sent me the $500 cashback card which can’t be activated because it looks like it’s from some dodgy gift card company which can’t be contacted. This was a material inducement to why I invested in a second of their batteries.Overall to date a terrible experience.

STAY AWAY!!!!! I do not recommend this company to anyone, I have been a customer of 1Komma5 since April this year and regret my decision, they are appalling for customer service. They offer everything at the sale stage and when things go wrong they don’t want to deal with it.Please read the reviews and the experience of others with 1Komma5, I was promised that customer service had changed and went with them, I regret my decision.

Prior to the federal battery rebate, I received a quotation and promised  a price reduction based on the Federal battery rebate.After 1/7/2025, I contact the sales team and ask for a quotation revision. And the sales lady gave me the revised quote (with rebate) it was nowhere near the discussion and price promised (supposed to be 350$ approximately for per kwh).The new price provided to me (for 20kwh battery) is only about $1500 difference.When I approach the sales lady, she has no interest in explaining the breakdown and simply asked me if I would like to cancel the contract. A little upset however I hold no position to ask the sales person to revise the price which is only verbal.However the most upsetting part is the sales person soon blocked my number and is yet to give me any confirmation details of how I will get my deposit refunded.I realised my mobile number is blocked by the Sales person and have to call with a unknown number, which she never pickup. I have to call the head office to make a complain (through 2 to 3 different calls before I can get the refund.)This review is only to rate the certain sales's customer service and way of dealing with customer.I have not receive any product , so hence this is not a product review.

Customer service from initial quote thru to installation has been excellent. Our current + new panels & new hybrid inverter are producing great results- our only issue is waiting on battery availability to finalise.

We have an existing 11.75 kw/hr solar system with micro inverters.After a google search I settled on a few providers and installers including Uncommon Solar.
